store_data.about_the_game:
Final Table is a single-player No Limit Hold’em game about learning the game, building better habits and putting your poker decisions to the test.

Use Guided Play and Coach Mode to learn how to think through a hand, understand the maths behind your decisions and review your mistakes after each pot.

Train specific skills with lessons and drills, then take what you have learned into Career Mode, where there is no coach at the table and every decision is yours.

No real-money gambling. No microtransactions. Just poker strategy, practice and improvement.

Features

Career - A ladder of Sit & Go events with rising blinds, real payouts and a bankroll to manage.

Guided Play - Let the coach guide you through the thought process for each hand, helping you decide what matters before you act.

Coach Mode - Cash tables at heads-up, short-handed or full ring, with live grading, a hand review after every pot, and reads on your opponents.

Lessons - Short interactive lessons, each paired with a drill.

Drills - Focused puzzles on reading hands, counting outs, estimating equity and pricing calls.

Hand history - Every hand replayable street by street, with the coach's verdicts attached.

Opponents - Face bot archetypes from Rookie to Maniac, each with different tendencies you can learn to spot and exploit.

Options - Four-colour deck, adjustable pace and an optional decision clock.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deli Simulator is a simple market and deli management game where you run your own small shop.

In the game, you order products, carry delivery boxes, stock your shelves, and wait for customers to shop. With the money you earn, you can buy new shelves, upgrade your store, and slowly grow your business.

This game was not made by a large studio. It is a project created by a small team with limited resources but a lot of passion. The game may still feel rough and early in some areas, but the core gameplay loop is already in place: product ordering, shelf stocking, customer flow, sales, shelf placement, and store upgrades.

Our goal is to keep improving the game over time and turn it into a richer, more enjoyable, and more alive simulation experience. We want to add more products, better visuals, sounds, employee systems, more store upgrades, and small details that make the shop feel more complete.

If you enjoy small business management games, or if you simply want to support independent developers, buying this game would truly help us. It may not be a perfect game right now, but every purchase gives us the motivation and opportunity to keep developing it.

Build your own deli shop, fill your shelves, welcome your customers, and become part of a small business growth journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gods of the Grid is a match-3 roguelike RPG set in the world of Greek mythology. Swap runes to attack, heal, raise shields and channel the powers of the gods, then push deeper into nine dungeons of monsters and bosses. You only get one life per run: fall, and the journey resets, but the legend you build carries on.

MATCH RUNES, COMMAND THE BATTLE

Every swap matters. Skulls strike your foe, hearts heal you, shields grant armor that soaks damage before your health, and coloured runes bank mana for your spells.

Line up four runes to blast a whole row and column, or five to wipe an entire colour, and either one earns you an extra turn. Chain cascades for bigger combos and higher scores. Every enemy also hides an elemental weakness and resistance, discovered as the fight unfolds, so knowing your foe matters as much as your build.

BECOME A DEMIGOD

Begin each run as the child of a god, one of six demigod classes with a distinct playstyle, some available from the start and others earned at the Temple.

Every level-up you choose one of eighteen boons to shape your build, including build-defining ones that change how you play rather than just raise a number, and you claim powerful relics from bosses and merchants. Thirty-four relics span damage, defense, mana, healing and devious skull-synergy effects.

CONQUER THE DUNGEONS

Nine themed dungeons stand between you and Olympus, each ending in a boss who telegraphs a devastating special attack and enrages at half health.

Enemies have distinct traits and elemental resistances, so every fight reads differently. Between battles you take the road: heal at a Shrine, gamble with the Oracle, claim gold at an Altar, or spend it at the Merchant. Choose Normal for a balanced run or Hard for a tougher fight and a score bonus.

RISK IT ALL, EVERY RUN COUNTS

When you fall, the run ends and the dungeons relock, but your feats (56 to earn) are kept forever and you earn Favor to permanently unlock new classes and relics at the Temple.

Climb the global leaderboard, or take on the Daily Challenge: the same seeded boards for every player, with its own daily ranking.

FEATURES

  • Roguelike runs with permadeath and persistent meta-progression

  • Six demigod classes, choose a boon from a pool of 18 (including build-defining ones), and more than 30 relics for varied builds

  • Nine dungeons, telegraphed boss specials, distinct enemy traits, and per-battle elemental weaknesses/resistances to discover

  • Normal and Hard difficulty modes

  • Global leaderboard and a daily seeded challenge

  • 56 feats to earn and a Temple to spend Favor on permanent unlocks

  • Crafted pixel art and a soundtrack that shifts between map, battle and boss

Match. Cast. Conquer. The gods are watching.

store_data.about_the_game:
UNLOAD is an interception-focused, top-down shooter where your ammo is your life. Intercept lethal bullet hell from all directions to reload, pushing through extreme, razor-thin crises. Stand against the cybernetic bosses dominating the city and execute your justice.

Your Ammo is Your Health

The remaining rounds in your magazine represent your very life force. Every time you pull the trigger against an enemy, you drain your own health. Deplete all your ammo, and you face imminent death. Will you willingly sacrifice your life to destroy your foes, or hold your fire to survive? In the midst of relentless combat, every second demands a strategic decision. Embrace the risk and unleash explosive firepower—experience the true essence of 'high risk, high return.'

Intercept Barrages to Turn the Tide

The enemy bullet hell pouring in from all sides isn't just a threat. Perfectly intercept incoming enemy attacks! Any barrage you intercept is instantly converted into your life force and offensive power: your ammo. The lower your health gets in extreme situations, the more you must willingly dive straight into the heart of a deadly bullet hell to survive.

Hardcore Boss Rush in a Lawless Mechanical City

A cold dystopia stained with neon lights—this city has already fallen into the hands of massive mechanized syndicates. Forget about tedious battles against small fry. Analyze and destroy the weak points of giant mechanical bosses boasting overwhelming firepower and ruthless screen-filling patterns. It's time to execute your own justice in this corrupted city.

store_data.about_the_game:
One computer. One room.

And records that were never erased.

<No Search Results> is a first-person mystery adventure about tracing the digital remains left behind online. Browse through web history, chats, emails, files, photos, and community sites as you collect clues and reconstruct the hidden truth buried across different records.

Search history becomes a clue. Photos become evidence. Conversations become traps.

The names and relationships you connect will change the outcome of the case.

Key Features

Experience a first-person mystery adventure where the entire investigation unfolds through one room and one computer.

Move between a browser, cult websites, chats, emails, file explorer, photos, notes, and an organization chart program to gather scattered clues.

Compare search history, deleted posts, locked folders, locations in photos, email dates, and the way people speak in chats to uncover hidden relationships.

Organize suspicious individuals by name and role, and find the real connections buried among false information.

Exploration through the monitor connects with everyday life in the real world. Time passes, days go by, and your choices affect the ending.

Restore the records someone tried to erase, and reach the truth behind a case that was meant to disappear.

store_data.about_the_game:
PSYCHE features a unique second person mechanic, where your play space is mirrored above you, and you can fire at enemies at the mirrored play spaces to deal more damage to the enemies that seek to shatter you.

Dodge enemies, watch your feet and carve an exit in first person, before switching back to second person to handle the unsettling number of enemies still chasing your tail.

Mastering your spatial awareness and target priority, as well as your movement skills is key to completing a run through your PSYCHE.

------------------------------

Backflip, frontlip and bunnyhop around your environment to outpace the surreal manifestations of the dream. Let your Moon charge it's beam to fire at the ground, giving yourself a leap of pace and escape tricky situations, or add a little flair to your latest attempt at a PB.

------------------------------

Compete for high scores, see your run stats and optimise, can you find a strategy that dwarfs all others? Learn to use the Roil mechanic to maximise your score and carve your own strat through the PSYCHE.

------------------------------

Review your gameplay, or others! With the replay system, you can find methods to optimise, or steal strats from your peers, to push your score further. Or just use it as a screensaver. Either/or.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mind Over Dice is a turn-based roguelike where dice are not just randomness — they're your primary resource. Enemies reveal their intentions before you act. You see who they're targeting, what spell they're casting, and where they're about to strike. Your task is to outplay them by distributing the rolled dice among your heroes.

🎲 Dice — Your Main Tool

At the start of each turn, you roll three dice. Rolled ones? That's not a verdict. That's a perfect combo! Every turn will throw new challenges at you. But you'll handle it. Right?

⚔️ Heroes with Character and Weak Spots

You have 10 heroes at your disposal. Each is a unique class with their own story and survival style. Each hero has 9 different spells. Warrior, mage, priest, hunter, shaman, paladin, someone, rogue, druid, and of course the cheeky gnome developer — they're all under your command. Well, except the last one.

Heroes unlock as you progress, and you decide who to bring on your next expedition.

👁️ Expeditions — The Core of the Game

The world is divided into a dozen thematic acts. Each has its own atmosphere, music, and monsters. In each act, a random map is generated, always ending with a boss.

Every fight is a small chess match where your main tool is dice. And you're the one in control. Probably.

At the start of a turn, enemies reveal their plans: who they'll attack, what spell they'll use. You see it all — and you build your defense. Stun the shaman about to cast a curse? Shield the hero the trolls are targeting? Or strike first so the enemy simply... doesn't get a turn?

There are also elite monsters, camps, shops, secrets, cards, artifacts, luck, ally support, and even... FARMING! No, no. Not what you think.

🔁 Your Progress — Not Just in Battles

The game remembers your victories. New heroes, new acts, new artifacts, new skins unlock. But the real progress is you becoming a better player. You start to feel when to take risks and when to play it safe. That's Mind Over Dice. Mind over dice. Mastery over randomness.

✨ Key Features

  • 🎲 Dice as a tactical resource — assign rolled values to your heroes.

  • 🧠 Transparent enemies — they show their moves before you act. Well, almost all of them.

  • ⚔️ 10 heroes with unique spells — from warrior to psychologist (oops, wasn't supposed to say that).

  • 🔁 High replayability — every run has a new map and new decisions.

  • 🃏 Hundreds of artifacts and achievements — collect, unlock, experiment.

🎮 Who This Game Is For

  • For those who want to relax in the evenings. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who love tactical puzzles and are used to winning. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who play more than just AAA games. Spoiler: you'll be screaming "AAAA" a lot.

Mind Over Dice is a challenge to your patience, wit, and willingness to take risks. There's no such thing as "bad luck" here. Only "I chose the wrong face."

Total playtime: 30-80 hours.

The game remembers your victories. New heroes, new acts, new artifacts, new skins unlock. But the real progress is you becoming a better player. You start to feel when to take risks and when to play it safe. That's Mind Over Dice. Mind over dice. Mastery over randomness.

✨ Key Features

  • 🎲 Dice as a tactical resource — assign rolled values to your heroes.

  • 🧠 Transparent enemies — they show their moves before you act. Well, almost all of them.

  • ⚔️ 10 heroes with unique spells — from warrior to psychologist (oops, wasn't supposed to say that).

  • 🔁 High replayability — every run has a new map and new decisions.

  • 🃏 Hundreds of artifacts and achievements — collect, unlock, experiment.

🎮 Who This Game Is For

  • For those who want to relax in the evenings. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who love tactical puzzles and are used to winning. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who play more than just AAA games. Spoiler: you'll be screaming "AAAA" a lot.

Mind Over Dice is a challenge to your patience, wit, and willingness to take risks. There's no such thing as "bad luck" here. Only "I chose the wrong face."

Total playtime: 30-80 hours.
store_data.short_description: Mind Over Dice is a tactical roguelike where luck becomes a weapon. Roll dice, assign values to your heroes, and outsmart cunning enemies. Heroes, cards, acts, secrets, artifacts, and much more! Every roll is a choice. Every face is fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
SLYTHE is an arcade shooter roguelite where you steer an ever-moving snake of heroes — each with their own attacks, passives, and classes. Inspired by auto-battlers: stack heroes of the same class for powerful class bonuses, buy copies to level them up, and build a snake that clears the arena on its own — if you steer it right.

Between arenas you play the economy: hire from the shop, bank gold for interest, ban the heroes you never want offered again, and shape a build from 80+ passive items with run-warping effects. Every sixth arena throws an elite at you; arena 25 holds the final boss. Beating it is where SLYTHE starts, not where it ends.

Gameplay

  • Your snake never stops moving — steer it with keyboard, mouse-follow, or gamepad (two stick modes)
  • Your heroes attack automatically when enemies are near
  • Combine heroes of the same class to unlock unique class bonuses
  • Clearing arenas grants gold — spend it, or bank it and earn interest
  • Buying copies of the same hero levels them up; at Lv.3 they unlock special effects
  • Ban heroes from the shop to sharpen your odds — build control is the real weapon

Beyond the win

  • True endless mode — difficulty keeps scaling for as long as you survive
  • Loop past arena 25 with a run-defining relic each time around
  • New Game+ tiers stack lasting difficulty for veteran builds
  • A global all-time leaderboard — names, avatars, and your rank right on the main menu
  • Custom runs with game-twisting modifiers when you want the rules bent

Features

  • 50+ heroes, each with unique attacks and passives
  • 15+ classes granting stat boosts and modifiers to your snake
  • 80+ passive items with run-warping global effects
  • Elite fights, a final boss, and rotating arena themes
  • 41 Steam achievements, from first blood to the ones we won't spoil
  • Post-run stat breakdowns for the theorycrafters
  • Full controller support with rebindable inputs, native on Steam Deck
  • An interactive tutorial that teaches steering in your own control scheme
  • A pumping synthwave soundtrack driving every wave

About This Game

Pirates Life is an online multiplayer pirate adventure where every player has their own account, builds a personal island, joins crews, explores a vast world, and creates their own pirate legacy.

Create and customize your own island by placing buildings, docks, decorations, workshops, and other structures to make it truly your own. Gather resources, craft equipment, and design the perfect pirate hideout.

Explore a world filled with unique islands, hidden treasures, quests, resources, and dangerous enemies. Search for buried treasure by digging at marked X locations to uncover valuable crates filled with coins. Spend your coins on buildings, decorations, equipment, ships, and other upgrades.

Create or join a Crew to adventure with other players. Work together to complete quests, defeat powerful enemies, collect treasure, and explore dangerous islands.

Communicate with the community using the Public Chat. Meet new players, recruit crew members, trade, or simply chat while exploring the seas.

Looking for action? Enter PvP and battle other players on land and at sea. Fire your ship's cannons, sink enemy vessels, board rival ships, and fight to protect your treasure or claim theirs.

Key Features

  • Fully online multiplayer experience.

  • Create your own player account and save your progress.

  • Build and customize your own island.

  • Explore a world filled with unique islands.

  • Hunt for buried treasure by digging at marked X locations.

  • Find treasure crates containing valuable coins.

  • Spend your coins on buildings, decorations, equipment, ships, and more.

  • Create or join a Crew with other players.

  • Public Chat to communicate with players around the world.

  • Gather resources and craft equipment.

  • Fight enemies and challenging bosses.

  • Engage in PvP with ship-to-ship combat and player battles.

  • Fire cannons, sink enemy ships, and battle rival pirates.

  • Discover hidden secrets and continue expanding your pirate adventure.

Whether you choose to become a legendary explorer, a fearless pirate captain, a skilled builder, or a treasure hunter, Pirates Life offers an online world where your adventure never ends.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the distant ancient era, a legendary mage obtained knowledge of the creation laws from another world and mastered powerful magic capable of destroying heaven and earth. In order to open up his own new world, he ruthlessly destroyed countless nations. The dragon race and giant race joined forces to fight him for thousands of years, ultimately sealing him in the dark demon domain. The giants and dragons guarded the barrier with their flesh and blood, strengthening the seal.

However, as long years passed, the guardians gradually corrupted, leaving only piles of dry bones. The sealing barrier weakened accordingly. The mage's remnant soul and evil thoughts attached to the bones, transforming into the terrifying Skeleton Demon God, constantly releasing corrupting particles to further weaken the barrier...

To save the continent on the verge of destruction, the protagonist is summoned by a mysterious power and embarks on an epic journey to the Skeleton Demon Domain to eliminate the Skeleton Demon God.

Game Features

  • Immersive Visual Feast: Excellent lighting and pixel art perfectly combined to create an ultimate atmosphere and deep immersion. Every frame is as exquisite as an oil painting.

  • Rich Weapon and Magic System: Multiple weapons and magic can be freely combined to unlock a vast array of combat combinations and create your unique fighting style.

  • Original Epic Soundtrack: Multiple custom shocking songs that enhance the story's appeal and world immersion.

  • Diverse Level Design: Rich and differentiated levels with intricate mechanisms, full of challenge and fun. Every exploration brings fresh surprises.

  • Exquisite Narrative Presentation: High-quality cutscenes and profound storytelling immerse you in this thousand-year legend of the Demon God.

What Was That?!

What Was That?! is a cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home after dark.

When the humans fall asleep, the house changes. Everyday objects become mysterious encounters. Some become friends. Others become enemies.

Explore different rooms, investigate strange objects, and face bizarre enemies inspired by things every pet knows — cardboard boxes, tangled yarn, robot vacuums, and more.

Build your deck, manage your Stress, and trust your instincts to survive until morning.

Features

  • 🐾 Play as a household pet.

  • 🃏 Build a unique deck during every run.

  • 🏠 Explore a home full of mysterious encounters.

  • 😺 Every object can become either a reward or a threat.

  • 🌙 Cozy atmosphere mixed with light suspense.

  • 🔄 Procedurally generated runs with different choices every night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? 🦆

Step into a peaceful, physics-based world where ducks slowly rain down from the sky. Mayhem Duck Simulator is the ultimate plastic duck simulator experience, designed for those who want to spend a calm day as well as those looking to stir up some serious trouble.

You aren't just a regular duck; you are the master of the pool! ✨

Key Features

  • Relax or Wreak Havoc: Whether you want to sunbathe and drift peacefully on the water or use your special abilities to turn the pool upside down, the choice is yours in this unique plastic duck simulator.

  • Unique "Special Ducks": Discover special ducks, each with their own unique powers!

    • Dragon Duck: Breathe fire! 🔥

    • UFO Duck: Abduct other ducks into the sky! 🛸

    • Wizard Duck: Grow your friends to massive sizes! ✨

    • Magnet Duck: Attract a flock and go on a road trip! 🦆

  • Rescue and Collect: Find the special ducks trapped behind iron bars, rescue them, and add them to your pool. Every new duck means a new type of chaos in your plastic duck simulator collection!

  • Customize: Take control of every duck, give them custom names, and grow your collection.

  • Sit Back and Unwind: No quests, no timers, no stress. Watch them drift like a screensaver on your second monitor while you work, or hop in during your coffee break to stir things up!

This game is perfect for you if:

  • You are looking for a fun plastic duck simulator that lets you escape from tedious quests and complex mechanics.

  • You are looking for a "relaxing" game that still lets you indulge in occasional madness.

  • You enjoy hilarious, physics-based sandbox fun. 🦆

There is a "relaxing" mode... but how long it stays relaxing depends entirely on your creativity! 😏

In Mayhem Duck Simulator, you will either find peace or create pure chaos. The choice is yours! ✨

store_data.about_the_game:
Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers

Bon Voyage!
Welcome to the world of Forturia!

In this world, every voyage is guided by the dice.

Forturia is a fantasy world inspired by the 16th-century Age of Exploration. You take on the role of a young captain leading a small trading company, traveling from port to port across the globe, buying and selling goods, opening up unknown seas, and taking on royal missions from your kingdom.

But you are not the only one seeking fortune on these waters.
A colorful cast of rival captains is also sailing the world, each driven by their own ambitions.

Which route will you take?
Which ports will you trade in?
Will you prioritize royal missions, or chase a chance at a massive profit?

Every choice you make can change the course of your destiny.

A Different Grand Voyage, Woven by Dice Every Time

Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers is a new kind of seafaring strategy game that blends board game movement, trading, strategy, and adventure.

Roll the dice to travel along sea routes, then buy and sell trade goods in ports around the world. Read the market, stack up profits, grow your fleet, and aim to become the greatest trading company in the world.

With maps that change every time you play, market prices that shift constantly, and rival captains competing for the same opportunities, no two voyages are ever the same.

A Free Voyage Across the World

A vast ocean awaits, filled with countless ports, trade goods, and undiscovered routes.

Discover new waters, expand the world map, and build your own ideal trade routes.

Sometimes storms will throw your plans into chaos. Sometimes unexpected fortune will smile upon you. Every voyage creates a new story.

A Party Adventure to Enjoy, Laugh, and Compete With Others

The world of Forturia is not only for solo players who want to take their time and plan carefully.

With online and local multiplayer, it can also be enjoyed as a party game that is easy to play with family and friends.

“If only I had one more space, I could have completed my royal mission!”
“You sold at that port? I wasn’t ready for that!”
“You’re using that item now!?”

Unexpected twists created by the dice, combined with the mind games between players, make every session feel like its own drama.

Luck alone will not bring victory.
But even the best strategy can be laughed away by the goddess of dice.

Because no one knows who will win until the very end, every voyage is filled with cheers, groans, and laughter.

It is a new seafaring party game where everyone can gather, compete, and have a great time.

A Story-Rich Campaign Mode and an Endlessly Replayable Versus Mode

Enjoy a story-rich campaign mode filled with meaningful encounters and journeys across the world, as well as a randomly generated versus mode where you can freely play against COM opponents or friends.

Roll the dice that decide your fate, trade from port to port, and outmaneuver rival captains.
Lead your trading company to glory in a fantasy world inspired by the Age of Exploration.

There Is More Than One Path to Victory

Build a vast fortune.

Complete more royal missions than anyone else.

Monopolize rare trade goods.

Explore the world and open up new sea routes.

What kind of captain you become is up to you.

Luck alone is not enough.
Strategy alone is not enough.

Only the captain who can master both fortune and judgment will become the ruler of Forturia.

Now, raise your sails.

Beyond the trade routes no one has yet discovered.

Development Staff

Developer: FUJIYAMA ENTERTAINMENT
Director & Original Concept: Shunsuke Katsumata
Character Design: Shu-chun
Sound Design: Soma

Brought to you by a small development team of four to five people.
We hope everyone will have a great time playing it together.

Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers is a new kind of seafaring strategy game that blends board game movement, trading, strategy, and adventure.

Roll the dice to travel along sea routes, then buy and sell trade goods in ports around the world. Read the market, stack up profits, grow your fleet, and aim to become the greatest trading company in the world.

With maps that change every time you play, market prices that shift constantly, and rival captains competing for the same opportunities, no two voyages are ever the same.

A Free Voyage Across the World

A vast ocean awaits, filled with countless ports, trade goods, and undiscovered routes.

Discover new waters, expand the world map, and build your own ideal trade routes.

Sometimes storms will throw your plans into chaos. Sometimes unexpected fortune will smile upon you. Every voyage creates a new story.

A Party Adventure to Enjoy, Laugh, and Compete With Others

The world of Forturia is not only for solo players who want to take their time and plan carefully.

With online and local multiplayer, it can also be enjoyed as a party game that is easy to play with family and friends.

“If only I had one more space, I could have completed my royal mission!”
“You sold at that port? I wasn’t ready for that!”
“You’re using that item now!?”

Unexpected twists created by the dice, combined with the mind games between players, make every session feel like its own drama.

Luck alone will not bring victory.
But even the best strategy can be laughed away by the goddess of dice.

Because no one knows who will win until the very end, every voyage is filled with cheers, groans, and laughter.

It is a new seafaring party game where everyone can gather, compete, and have a great time.

A Story-Rich Campaign Mode and an Endlessly Replayable Versus Mode

Enjoy a story-rich campaign mode filled with meaningful encounters and journeys across the world, as well as a randomly generated versus mode where you can freely play against COM opponents or friends.

Roll the dice that decide your fate, trade from port to port, and outmaneuver rival captains.
Lead your trading company to glory in a fantasy world inspired by the Age of Exploration.

There Is More Than One Path to Victory

Build a vast fortune.

Complete more royal missions than anyone else.

Monopolize rare trade goods.

Explore the world and open up new sea routes.

What kind of captain you become is up to you.

Luck alone is not enough.
Strategy alone is not enough.

Only the captain who can master both fortune and judgment will become the ruler of Forturia.

Now, raise your sails.

Beyond the trade routes no one has yet discovered.

Development Staff

Developer: FUJIYAMA ENTERTAINMENT
Director & Original Concept: Shunsuke Katsumata
Character Design: Shu-chun
Sound Design: Soma

Brought to you by a small development team of four to five people.
We hope everyone will have a great time playing it together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mini Mayor: 12 Years is a city-building and management sandbox game where you build a city, manage its budget, and survive the world of politics.

You become the newly elected mayor and govern the city for 12 years.
Build roads, develop residential and commercial districts, expand education, public safety, healthcare, and industry, and guide your city toward growth.

But being a mayor is not just about building a better city.

As elections approach, you must make promises to your citizens.
During your term, you can choose whether to keep those promises or ignore them.
You can spend the budget on the city’s future, or use your position to pursue personal wealth and political gain.

You may become a great mayor who serves the people.
Or you may become a politician who talks about prosperity in public while quietly filling your own pockets behind the scenes.

Your choices will change the direction of the city, the reactions of your citizens, and the outcome of your political career.
In the end, the ending you reach will depend on what kind of mayor you chose to become.

City Building and Management
Place residential, commercial, industrial, and public facilities while managing the city’s population and finances.

Politics and Elections
Choose campaign promises, manage public approval and party support, and win elections to stay in power.

Aim for Three Consecutive Terms
One term is not enough. Hold on to power for 12 years and successfully win three terms as mayor.

Choices with Different Consequences
Choices made for the city, choices made for political survival, and choices made for personal gain will all lead to different results.

Multiple Endings
The ending will change depending on what kind of city you built and how you used your power.

Will you build a great city,
or will you build a great fortune for yourself?

The choice is yours.

Enjoy everything that love and an endless life has to offer!

store_data.about_the_game:
🏆 The Birth of a "New Strategy Triangle Reversi"!

Experience an unprecedented take on Reversi, using triangular pieces where "two" pieces fit into a single square!

The traditional "take the corners" strategy is completely shattered, marking the dawn of a brand-new intellectual battle.

Developed with passion by Japanese solo-developer Nakamura, experience a revolutionary title that will change the history of Reversi!

🎮 【CONCEPT】 A Digital Brain Battle in an 80s Cyber Space

The stage is a cyber world hacked by an AI virus.

Immerse yourself in retro-futuristic, 80s cyberpunk-style sounds and visuals as you take on the challenge to save the world from this digital threat.

⚠️ 【NEW RULE】 Original Rules That Defy Convention

The biggest appeal of this game is that the pieces are "right isosceles triangles." This creates an entirely new layer of strategy where conventional wisdom no longer applies.

① Two Pieces per Square!

Each square is divided by a diagonal line, allowing up to two pieces to be placed in a single square. The orientation of the pieces (combinations of 4 directions) will drastically shift the tide of battle.

② Sandwiching is Only Vertical/Horizontal! 【No Diagonals ❌】

While the basic rule of sandwiching and flipping opponent pieces remains, the triangular structure makes diagonal sandwiching absolutely impossible! Dominating the vertical (up/down) and horizontal (left/right) lines is the ultimate key to victory.

💎 【SPECIAL】 Your Comeback Partner: The "Bit"

When more than half of the board is filled, the crystal "Bit" on the right side of the screen awakens!

By clicking it, you can activate a powerful skill to "transform an enemy piece into your own" just once per game.

However, using it comes with a high-risk, high-reward twist: an enemy counterattack will grant your opponent two consecutive turns immediately after. Knowing exactly when to use the "Bit" will decide your fate!

🖱️ 【FEATURES】 Smooth Gameplay & Multiplayer

* Intuitive Controls: Perfect for beginners! The game progresses simply by intuitively clicking, fully supporting both mouse and controller.

* Hint Feature: "Translucent hint pieces" automatically appear where you can place a piece, helping you get used to the new rules instantly.

* Local Multiplayer: Enjoy heated battles with friends or family on a single screen!

🎵 【SOUND】 Premium All-8-Bit Audio!

From the background music to the sound effects and jingles, all 30+ tracks featured in the game are created entirely with retro 8-bit sounds!

Composed exclusively by up-and-coming professional composer Koko-Watt, these ultimate chiptune tracks will fully immerse you in the 80s cyber space!

store_data.about_the_game:
🎂 Welcome to Cake & Bake! 🍰✨

Step into the warm, fresh-out-of-the-oven world of Cake & Bake! Welcome to a peaceful baking simulator where you will create colorful cakes for your adorable and sweet customers. Choose your ingredients, use various kitchen tools, and craft the desserts of your dreams — all inside a heartwarming, cozy bakery!

🧑‍🍳 Bake the Flavor Step-by-Step

Take your customers' orders and step up to the counter. Master every recipe, from classic sponges to multi-layered, colorful birthday cakes. Mix the batter and set the oven to the perfect temperature. Thanks to all the decoration and baking steps, preparing each cake turns into a delightful and rewarding experience!

🛒 Explore the Town Market

The most delicious cakes are made with the freshest ingredients! When you run low on supplies or need exotic fruits for a special recipe, drop by the charming market in town. Stroll through the aisles, add the freshest strawberries, highest quality chocolates, and colorful sprinkles to your basket. Proper shopping is the first secret to a perfect cake!

🍓 Let Your Imagination Run Wild

Frost your cakes exactly how you want, and decorate them with adorable cream figures, fresh fruits, and glossy glazes. Creating visual feasts that will charm even the pickiest customers is entirely up to your creativity!

🧼 A Sweet End-of-Day Closure

After a busy and flavor-packed day, it's time to prep your bakery for tomorrow! Clean up the counter at the end of the day, wash the mixer bowls, piping bags, and trays in soapy, bubbly water, bringing a sparkling order back to your bakery. Washing the dishes and cleaning the kitchen will turn into a deeply peaceful and satisfying ritual that makes you forget all your tiredness!

🌸 Peaceful Atmosphere and Adorable Graphics

Every corner of Cake & Bake is filled with sweetness and a cozy style. No time limits, no rush, no stress. This peaceful atmosphere will make you forget the outside world as you decorate your cakes or imagine the aroma of a cake fresh out of the oven, all accompanied by relaxing background music.

Key Features

  • 🥣 Interactive Kitchen Tools: Actively use mixers, ovens, piping bags, and many other kitchen utensils.

  • 🍰 Colorful Cakes: Prepare sponges, pies, and custom-designed cakes for your customers.

  • 🛍️ Adorable Market Shopping: Visit the town market to handpick and purchase the freshest and most colorful ingredients for your cakes.

  • 🎨 Sweet and Soft Visuals: A completely "cozy" visual style with a heartwarming color palette that is easy on the eyes.

  • 🎵 Relaxing Music: Peaceful melodies to help you unwind after a busy day.

Welcome to your new position. Your duties are straigforward: listen to tapes, identify audio anomalies, and complete your shift. Everything you need is already provided. Just focus on your work.

LEARN THE RULES

Every creature follows its own set of rules. Listen for knocks, watch the vents, hide at right moment, and adapt as new mechanics are introduced. Paying attention is the key to staying alive, because every mistake bringes the entities one step closer.

EVERY DAY GETS HARDER

New gameplay mechanics are introduced day after day, steadily increasing the challenge without replacing what you already learned. You'll need to multitask and stay calm under pressure if you hope to survive until the final shift.

TEST YOURSELF

Once you've completed the game, challenge yourself with unique game modes that change the gameplay. Face remixed mechanics, earn achievements, and prove you've mastered every rule the facility has to offer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Short battles. Subtle decisions. Big consequences.

Cardume is a real-time 1v1 card battler. Two swarms of thousands of living cells fight in a glowing arena. Steer yours with a handful of one-time cards. Lure the swarm onto a point, rally it into a charge, trigger a gorge, freeze an enemy assault. You can't micromanage individual cells, but a few well-timed plays ripple through thousands of them and swing the whole match.

Emergent warfare

Your cells obey simple rules, but the war that emerges from thousands of them is something neither player can fully predict. Learn to read the swarm so you can anticipate your enemy and tip the balance of the medium in your favor.

Win two ways

  • Domination: hold the arena's richest nutrient points and race to the victory-point goal.
  • Conversion: assimilate the enemy until their swarm collapses.
Lean defensive and hold the map and your cards, or go for the throat. Acid trails, cryo blasts, spore clouds, membranes. Every card reshapes the living system in real time.

Modes

  • Draft: open boosters, build a deck on the fly, and run it as far as you can, ranked against humans or against bots on your own.
  • Constructed: bring your own preconfigured swarm into the ladder.
  • Challenges: a hand-built ladder that teaches one idea at a time.
  • Auto-battler: prefer to just watch? Configure a swarm, set it loose hands-off, and let it fight rival swarms on its own.

A living, luminous arena

Abstract, bioluminescent, faintly psychedelic. Cardume is built to be
mesmerising to watch as much as to play. Light, motion, and emergent life.

store_data.about_the_game:
Professor's wife's spasm private lessons - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Fitness coach Victor was on the verge of death in the Paris subway explosion and was reborn after being transformed by the No. 7 consciousness insect, gaining special abilities. He met Eleanor, the wife of a philosophy professor, and gradually got involved in the struggle against the FX Group during his contact with her. Victor needs to find a balance between power and humanity while dealing with the crisis brought about by the awakening of the ancient rift entity.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of technological and mysterious elements. The FX Group conducts taboo experiments such as consciousness chip transplantation, treating humans as pawns and experimental subjects. Elements such as the ancient Balance Management Department, consciousness insects, and quantum rifts add a touch of fantasy and science fiction to the story.
Highlights of female character interaction: Eleanor is a mature woman with a cold and noble temperament, suppressing her desire for attention and control in her heart. The interaction between her and Victor is full of tension and emotional entanglement. From the initial exploration to the later mutual trust and dependence, the relationship between the two gradually warms up.
Tension in character relationships: There is both emotional attraction and cooperation and mutual support in the process of fighting against the FX Group between Victor and Eleanor. At the same time, Victor also has to face the pursuit of the FX Group and the threat of the ancient rift entity, making the character relationships complex and full of tension.
Scene features: The story scenes are rich and diverse, from the explosion site in the Paris subway tunnel, to the private lessons in the high - end fitness club, to the apartment near the Sorbonne University, the café by the Seine River, and the top - floor club hall. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and characteristics.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Victor's perspective to deeply experience his various experiences after obtaining special abilities, feel the emotional changes between him and Eleanor, and the excitement of fighting against the FX Group and the ancient crisis. It's as if they are in this world full of technology and mystery.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition pictures to vividly show the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details, bringing players an immersive visual experience. Whether it's Eleanor's charming posture or Victor's display of special abilities, they will all be presented in beautiful pictures.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. It has a one - click backtracking function, which is convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic playback function allows players to experience the story more easily. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. There is also a high - definition CG display, bringing players a more intuitive visual enjoyment, and the smooth reading experience allows players to be fully immersed.

store_data.about_the_game:
"They race for the sunset"

The Curse of Dracula is a compact gothic digital board game of pursuit and terror, played out upon a living map of mist-shrouded roads, lonely villages, ruined chapels, forgotten abbeys, and cursed mountain passes.

Lead a party of vampire hunters across Transylvania in a single-session hunt lasting roughly 45–120 minutes. Each turn advances the clock by two hours. Choose whether your hunters move, search for coffins and clues, gather supplies, rest from their wounds, prepare against danger, or manage the weapons and holy relics they carry.

The hunt changes from run to run. Coffins, guardians, useful items, hazards, and events are shuffled across the map. Dracula’s influence rises as dusk falls, making the roads more dangerous and his servants more powerful. Wolves stalk the forests. The dead stir in their graves. Vampire thralls guard cursed sites. False leads waste precious time.

Search the abbeys, chapels, villages, crypts, and ruins. Find the coffins. Defeat the guardians. Burn what lies within.

When the coffins are destroyed, gather the surviving hunters at the Castle Gate and enter the finale: a sequence of castle encounters leading to Dracula himself. One final chance to end the curse of Dracula, or to join his legion of the damned.

Generative AI Disclosure

This game was created with the assistance of generative AI tools for visual assets, music, and coding. All generated material was extensively edited, arranged, curated, and directed by the developer. The gameplay design, UI layout, visual style, and overall creative vision are the result of significant human authorship.

store_data.about_the_game:
Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world overcome by darkness.
Construct various buildings on a hex-based map to generate light and other resources.
Vanquish the darkness every cycle to expand your territory! 

Choose a new building every round to place in your village.
Pay attention to the various conditions and effects the buildings have and capitalize on the synergies between them. 

Generate enough light to overcome the darkness threshold each cycle and make sure to keep up with its scaling.

We’re a small team of developers based in Vienna, Austria. Seed of Light was mostly made as part of our college thesis, but is now being developed in our free time. We’re excited to show what we’ve been working on!
Feel free to contact us about feedback or any issues that may arise. :)

store_data.about_the_game:
DEADLY MURDOKU

Un cadáver. Una habitación cerrada. Una sala llena de sospechosos que no piensan hablar. En Deadly Murdoku no hay armas ni persecuciones: solo tú, la tiza y una verdad escondida en la geometría fría de la escena del crimen. Aquí la lógica es la única arma, y todo asesino comete un error.

LEE LA ESCENA COMO UN DETECTIVE

Cada sospechoso estuvo en algún sitio la noche del crimen. Las pistas no mienten: quién estaba junto a la planta, quién sentado bajo la ventana, quién dos salas al norte del cuerpo. Deduce el lugar exacto de cada uno, colócalos a todos sin una sola contradicción y acorrala al único que se quedó a solas con la víctima. Ese es tu asesino. Nómbralo y cierra el caso.

UNA CAMPAÑA DE NOVELA NEGRA

Ponte en la gabardina de Arthur Vance, un detective quemado que corrige exámenes en un sótano para no volver a juzgar a nadie. Veinte casos hechos a mano lo arrastran de vuelta al oficio, escalando una conspiración en la Universidad de San Jude hacia un cerebro que el campus enterró hace un año. Cada crimen es un mensaje dirigido a él, y cada pista pagada con sangre.

UNA HISTORIA QUE SE LEE COMO UN CÓMIC

Capítulos cinematográficos, un Diario del caso que reúne a cada asesino y cada víctima, y un misterio final que solo el detective más afilado sabrá resolver. La narrativa se desvela a medida que cierras casos: descubre el móvil, ata los cabos y llega hasta el nombre que nadie se atrevía a pronunciar.

DEDUCCIÓN LIMPIA, SIN SUERTE

Nada de culpables sacados de la manga. Cada caso tiene una sola solución, demostrable con pura lógica: la pista que condena al asesino siempre está sobre la mesa. Insinuamos, nunca mentimos. Tu ingenio es lo único que separa la condena del error.

JUEGO LIBRE ILIMITADO

¿Se acabó la campaña? El crimen nunca duerme. Genera casos infinitos en tres tamaños, de aprendiz a maestro detective, y afina tu instinto tanto como quieras. Cada partida, una escena nueva; cada escena, una verdad esperando a ser leída.

Coge la tiza, detective. El caso te espera.

store_data.about_the_game:
Where the Story Begins

Step into your first job with a passion for creativity. Meet coworkers with unique personalities as you struggle between your dreams and your career. Share a home in the big city, reunite with someone from your past, and discover what lies ahead...

This is a story for those searching for their way. While moving forward through life, embrace who you truly are, overcome every winding road together with the one you've chosen, and find the perfect ending.

Characters

  • Kazuma Ookamiya: Your housemate and former high school classmate whom you unexpectedly meet again. He works multiple part-time jobs.

  • Yuki Hashi: The protagonist, who joins Gentaku as an intern in spring.

  • Shunsuke Ninomiya: A gentle and dependable senior coworker with exceptional skills who takes special care of you.

  • Susumu Naota: A spring intern at Gentaku who struggles with family issues.

  • Takashi Itsuno: A full-time employee in Gentaku's Tachibana Team. Gloomy and unpredictable.

  • Wataru Natsukawa: A young genius in the industry with extraordinary talent, and your direct supervisor.

  • Masafumi Arimoto: A spring intern at Gentaku and your university classmate.

  • Tomoe Shimizu: An experienced full-time employee in Gentaku's Tachibana Team.

Gameplay

  • Improve your abilities: Focus on work while balancing daily life.

  • Choose locations to trigger events: Explore after work or go on dates during your days off.

  • Build relationships: Communicate, make choices, get to know him, and deepen your bond.

Features

  • Live2D Character Animation: Expressive emotions with delightful reactions.

See every breath and heartbeat come to life before your eyes!

store_data.about_the_game:
Velocity Fall is a fast, exhilarating first-person vertical-descent platformer. The goal is simple: plunge as fast as possible through walls, obstacles, and hazards... without splattering on the ground. The faster you go, the bigger the reward — but one mistake and it's a fatal impact.

Master your speed, or die. A dynamic velocity bar tells you everything: Green (safe), Orange (nail a timed Reception or take damage), Red (deadly on landing unless you pull off something clever), and Black (terminal velocity, instant death). Every zone changes how you play.

The wall is your best friend.

Wall Fall to slow down and regain control

Wall Run to keep your momentum at full speed

Perfect Wall Jump — a surgically-timed billiard-ball bounce that preserves your speed

Charged Jump for explosive relaunches

Chain your runs. Timed receptions, bunny hops to keep your momentum, checkpoints, and a replay system to study your best descents.

Infinite Fall. Levels generated along the fall axis, in Survival, Distance, or Normal modes. The golden rule: you only clear a run while in the green zone — otherwise, it's overtime.

Items & props. Trampolines, catapults, gravity zones, wind tunnels. Grab a parachute, energy drink, or grappling hook to turn a doomed dive into a legendary run.

Difficulty modifiers. From Weak Gravity (chill) to Iron Man (one death = back to the start). Tune your own challenge.

Are you fast enough to fall... and survive?

store_data.about_the_game:
The Peg Mines is a pachinko/plinko-like incremental game about mining for tons of ore by playing pachinko.

Enter the mines where pegs are your ore and balls are your pickaxes! By shooting ore, you'll be breaking up tons of pegs into ore that can be collected and crafted into new upgrades and unique balls.

As you progress through the mines, you'll earn ore to be used for upgrades.

This game features incremental progressions in the form of:

  • Increasing the amount of ore received per peg

  • Increasing the amount of pegs in the mines

  • Increasing multipliers

  • and more!

Crafting can offer a bigger benefit than standard upgrades.

This game also features a crafting system where you can choose to spend your ore on creating unique balls that may fit your playstyle. The better you are at crafting, the higher multiplier your newly created ball will receive. The crafting mini-game plays more like a standard pachinko game, and the better you perform, the better the result!

Gather ore, craft unique balls and gather even more ore!

Different balls have different effects, like increasing ore amounts, splitting into two or adding more multipliers! The further you go, the more ore will be needed to progress, these can give you a real edge.

store_data.about_the_game:
A clash of gods, played over sixty four squares.

Two thrones face each other across the board. The old gods bring their feuds here, where spears become pieces and Ragnarok plays out one move at a time. Three rule sets share the same field. Pick the contest that suits your hand.

Classic Chess

The old game of kings, as mortals have played it for a thousand winters. Castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, and the fifty move rule. Every law of the contest, kept as it was given.

Odin's Gambit

A chess variant where you raise your host as you play. Each turn, every warrior on your board marches once, in the order they answered your call. Beside the board you hold a hand of cards, each one a piece waiting to be set down. Spend a card each turn, plant a new warrior on its home square, and build your army as the match unfolds. Same goal as chess: cut down the enemy king.

Odin's Bounty

Odin's Gambit with a roguelike layer. Every foe your warrior fells leaves something behind. A level, a gift, a piece of their spirit. At the end of your turn, choose one of two boons for the slayer: greater reach, a new direction, the art of leaping over a kinsman, a second strike after a kill, and many more. By the time the last king falls, your warriors are unrecognizable from the ones that took the field. No two matches unfold the same way.

Three paths into battle

  • The hearth. Two players, one device. A curtain falls between turns so neither side glimpses the other's hand.

  • Versus. Host a match and share the join code. Battle anyone, anywhere. Best of three, five, or seven series.

  • Alone against the gods. Solo play in any of the three contests.

A fair contest

  • No tribute. No premium relics. No merchants at the gate. Earn what you want by playing.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game


Intended Parties is an Adult Romance Visual Novel about power, consent, and the cost of "doing good" at scale.

You play Lowell Vance, founder of Mariposa Family—the nation's most trusted "ethical" surrogacy agency. You are days away from a lucrative acquisition and a glossy relaunch when a buried medical warning resurfaces, a lawsuit tightens, and another carrier is flagged mid-protocol.

Three women step into your orbit at once. Choose who you face first, and discover whether romance can survive when the safest story in the room turns out to be the kindest lie.

Meet the Cast




Paloma Carrillo — The Doula
Paloma is Lucia Carrillo's older sister and a community doula who has spent her life keeping other women safe—only to watch her own sister be permanently harmed by Lowell's agency. She doesn't come for a payout; she comes for an answer that money can't replace. With Lowell, she finds herself drawn to the steadiness she has always provided for everyone else… and torn apart by what it would mean to accept it from him.



Rosalind "Roz" Aldous — The Medical Director
Roz is Mariposa's clinical conscience: brilliant, exacting, and the doctor who flagged Lucia's life-threatening risk—only to be overruled until her signature became part of the harm. She is Lowell's employee and a witness against his company, making their attraction both unethical and explosive. Where Lowell talks, Roz measures; where he sells, she sets terms.



Briar Nash — The Abolitionist
A former surrogate turned relentless organizer, Briar is the adversary Lowell can't charm, buy, or "mission" his way around—because she believes his kind version of the industry is the most dangerous one. She brings affidavits, scars, and a movement hungry for proof, and she treats Lowell like the best lie the business ever told. Falling for him would cost her credibility; wanting him feels like betrayal—and she hates that it's real.

Key Features

  • One decisive choice, three intense romance routes. A single-branch choice structure where the first door you walk toward shapes everything that follows.
  • High-stakes contemporary drama with grounded realism: acquisitions, legal holds, medical boards, and PR spin collide with intimate relationships.
  • Three distinct romance dynamics: a forbidden-by-faction rivalry with an anti-surrogacy abolitionist, an intimate bond with a doula seeking truth, and forbidden attraction with an off-limits employee and key witness.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.
  • A protagonist who can't talk his way out forever. Lowell's greatest skill—making people feel safe—becomes the very thing the story interrogates.

Content Notice

This game is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences. It features explicit sexual content, emotionally intense romantic scenarios, and mature themes including medical/ethical conflict, legal pressure, and discussions of bodily autonomy and consent.

store_data.about_the_game:
CASE OF 1980 is a psychological horror game set in the tense, mystery-filled atmosphere of the 1990s.

Story:
The story takes place in 1995 and follows Nathan, who wakes up in his apartment in Texas to the ringing of his landline phone. The caller is his grandfather, who asks Nathan to look after the family farm while he travels to attend a funeral in a town far outside the county.

Nathan agrees and heads to the farm. At first, everything seems perfectly normal. However, as time passes, the situation quickly spirals out of control. Nathan finds himself hunted by forces from the other side, all connected to a mysterious case dating back to 1980 a case with deep ties to the very place where he now stands.



Features:

First-person psychological horror.

A fast-paced, immersive horror experience.

A tense atmosphere inspired by the 1990s.

A variety of locations and story-driven events.




Gameplay:

CASE OF 1980 is a single-player narrative exploration game with a walking simulator style. As the story unfolds, players explore the environment, uncover clues, and complete various tasks using the required tools to progress through the events.

store_data.about_the_game:
Exclusive Training of Female Officer - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: In the NATO secret training ground, Gabrielle Clark was framed by Hannah Ringgren and was on the verge of death after being hit by biochemical shrapnel in the chest. At a critical moment, she fused with the seventh consciousness insect and miraculously woke up in the military camp's temporary medical room. After that, she will engage in a power struggle with Ringgren and gradually uncover the smuggling conspiracy of the FX Group within NATO .
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of a sense of technology and conspiracy. There are hidden dirty deals within NATO. Elements such as consciousness insects and quantum servers add a mysterious science - fiction color to the story. The ancient rift is also quietly fluctuating, and the situation is complex and tense.
Highlights of female character interactions: The interaction between Gabrielle and Ringgren is full of tension. Ringgren is cold and domineering, trying to control Gabrielle; while Gabrielle shows her edge in forbearance and skillfully counter - attacks Ringgren. There is both hatred of being framed and a subtle emotional undercurrent between the two. In addition, Gabrielle also has wonderful conversations with female characters such as Foster Madison, showing the wisdom and charm of different female characters .
Tension in character relationships: Gabrielle and Ringgren are in a hostile relationship. Ringgren wants to kill Gabrielle to cover up the smuggling crime, while Gabrielle is determined to uncover the truth. At the same time, Gabrielle is connected with Ozan Shahin, Li Na, Chen Yong and others from the Balance Management Department through the consciousness network. They cooperate with each other but have different views and suggestions, making the character relationships more complex.
Scene features: The story scenes are rich and diverse, including the explosion remnants in the NATO secret training ground, the beeping of instruments in the military camp's temporary medical room, and the tense confrontation in the temporary conference room. Each scene creates a unique atmosphere through delicate descriptions, making players feel as if they are on the scene .
Immersive experience: Players will follow Gabrielle's perspective, feeling her pain of being on the verge of death, the shock of fusing with the consciousness insect, and the tension of confronting the enemy. In this process, players will deeply experience the difficulty of Gabrielle in finding a balance between power and humanity, as if they are the protagonist in the story.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details. Whether it is Ringgren's cold and beautiful face, the silver - blue data stream in Gabrielle's eyes, or the purple - black light of the quantum server, they will all be presented to players in beautiful pictures .
Functional gameplay features: The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic play function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly find the parts they are interested in, and the high - definition CG adds more visual enjoyment to the story. The smooth reading experience allows players to fully immerse themselves in the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Make the 100-year-old underworld queen regain her youth and become my servant - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction
The low-class white youth Benjamin awakens the nano power on the verge of death while protecting Ava, the nightclub manager. He not only heals himself but also defeats the gangsters. Then he makes a deal with the dying underworld old lady Sophia, using nano - reshaping to make her return to her peak at 35. Sophia becomes his loyal servant. However, Nick Zimmerman has noticed him, and the crisis is quietly approaching.
Worldview atmosphere
The story constructs a world full of science - fiction elements. Elements such as silver - blue nano power, consciousness projection, and genetic experiments are intertwined, creating a mysterious and unknown atmosphere. Scenes like the back alley of the Black Swan Nightclub in Sydney, the private ward of the Carter family, and the private basement room of the old mansion add a sense of reality and fantasy to the story.
Highlights of female character interactions
Ava is full of admiration and gratitude towards Benjamin and promises to provide help for him. Sophia goes from initial reluctance to complete submission, and the master - servant relationship between her and Benjamin is full of tension and temptation. They each have their own charm, and their interactions with Benjamin add emotional color to the story.
Tension in character relationships
Benjamin and Ava have a relationship of protector and protected, while he and Sophia have a master - servant relationship. Sophia's descendants are coveting her inheritance, and Benjamin also faces the threat of Nick Zimmerman. These complex character relationships make the story full of conflicts and suspense.
Scene features
The back alley of the Black Swan Nightclub in Sydney is filled with the smell of damp sea breeze and cheap perfume, and the neon lights are flickering. The private ward of the Carter family and the private basement room of the old mansion are full of a mysterious atmosphere. The descriptions of these scenes are vivid and realistic, making players feel as if they are on the scene.
Immersive experience
Players will follow Benjamin's perspective, experiencing plots such as life - and - death crises, mysterious transactions, and master - servant training, and feel the tension and excitement of the story. At the same time, the delicate emotional descriptions and rich inner monologues of the characters allow players to deeply experience the emotional changes of the characters.
High - definition visual performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the flow of silver - blue nano power, the delicate expressions of characters, and the delicate details of scenes. Whether it is the back alley of the nightclub, the reshaping process in the ward, or the training scene in the private room, they will all be presented to players in high - quality graphics.
Functional gameplay features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function is convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic play function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function can quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. The high - definition CG shows wonderful moments, bringing a smooth reading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Frostward is a deep survival management colony simulator where every villager matters and every winter is a test. Featuring Day 1 Steam Workshop integration, this cozy but tense experience tasks you with guiding a small group of settlers through a harsh, procedurally generated wilderness.

Expand your borders, establish complex supply chains, and battle the elements as you transform a struggling outpost into a thriving colony island.

Every Colonist Has a Story

Your villagers are individuals, not just statistics. Each colonist has a name, sex, age, life stage, skills, and traits. They are born, they grow up, they learn trades, and they eventually grow old. As they work as woodcutters, miners, or crafters, their skills improve, making them faster and more productive over time. Unused skills slowly decay, rewarding careful management and specialization.

Winter is a Boss Fight

Three interlocking needs drive your colony: Hunger, Warmth, and Health. Spring and summer offer a calm building experience where crops grow and wild resources flourish, but the turn of the seasons brings severe danger. Winter halts farming, accelerates hunger, and drastically drains warmth. You must prepare fuel, stockpile medicine, and build a network of lit hearths to survive daily weather events like cold snaps and blizzards. If a villager's core warmth or health drops to zero, they will incapacitate and eventually die if left untreated.

Era Progression: From Camp to Colony

Advance your settlement through distinct eras, unlocking powerful new technologies and expanding your borders.

  • The Camp Era: Establish your foundation with basic housing, sawmills, and foraging keeps to survive the first harsh seasons.

  • The Town Era: Unlock masonry, distilleries, and a marketplace to begin trading surplus goods for gold with neighboring towns.

  • The Colony Era: Reach the late game by expanding across the island. Build enduring infrastructure, optimize complex resource chains, and establish a permanent, thriving hub of civilization in a once-frozen wasteland.

A Living, Procedural World

No two colonies are alike. Every map is procedurally generated from a unique seed, featuring layered biomes ranging from towering Taiga forests and Meadows to arid Oases and Coastal Kelp Forests. The world is alive with roaming wildlife that breeds daily and regrows after harsh winter losses. Set up dedicated forestry keeps, herbalist huts, and fishing docks to create sustainable resource loops that work in harmony with the environment.

Built for Architects and Modders

Presented in a charming 2D pixel-art style with a classic skeuomorphic interface, Frostward provides an accessible top-down view alongside a deep command console for power users.

With Day 1 Steam Workshop support, the game is built entirely on open content registries for limitless community creativity. store_data.detailed_description:
Frostward is a deep survival management colony simulator where every villager matters and every winter is a test. Featuring Day 1 Steam Workshop integration, this cozy but tense experience tasks you with guiding a small group of settlers through a harsh, procedurally generated wilderness.

Expand your borders, establish complex supply chains, and battle the elements as you transform a struggling outpost into a thriving colony island.

Every Colonist Has a Story

Your villagers are individuals, not just statistics. Each colonist has a name, sex, age, life stage, skills, and traits. They are born, they grow up, they learn trades, and they eventually grow old. As they work as woodcutters, miners, or crafters, their skills improve, making them faster and more productive over time. Unused skills slowly decay, rewarding careful management and specialization.

Winter is a Boss Fight

Three interlocking needs drive your colony: Hunger, Warmth, and Health. Spring and summer offer a calm building experience where crops grow and wild resources flourish, but the turn of the seasons brings severe danger. Winter halts farming, accelerates hunger, and drastically drains warmth. You must prepare fuel, stockpile medicine, and build a network of lit hearths to survive daily weather events like cold snaps and blizzards. If a villager's core warmth or health drops to zero, they will incapacitate and eventually die if left untreated.

Era Progression: From Camp to Colony

Advance your settlement through distinct eras, unlocking powerful new technologies and expanding your borders.

  • The Camp Era: Establish your foundation with basic housing, sawmills, and foraging keeps to survive the first harsh seasons.

  • The Town Era: Unlock masonry, distilleries, and a marketplace to begin trading surplus goods for gold with neighboring towns.

  • The Colony Era: Reach the late game by expanding across the island. Build enduring infrastructure, optimize complex resource chains, and establish a permanent, thriving hub of civilization in a once-frozen wasteland.

A Living, Procedural World

No two colonies are alike. Every map is procedurally generated from a unique seed, featuring layered biomes ranging from towering Taiga forests and Meadows to arid Oases and Coastal Kelp Forests. The world is alive with roaming wildlife that breeds daily and regrows after harsh winter losses. Set up dedicated forestry keeps, herbalist huts, and fishing docks to create sustainable resource loops that work in harmony with the environment.

Built for Architects and Modders

Presented in a charming 2D pixel-art style with a classic skeuomorphic interface, Frostward provides an accessible top-down view alongside a deep command console for power users.

With Day 1 Steam Workshop support, the game is built entirely on open content registries for limitless community creativity. You can easily browse the Workshop to download or create mods that add entirely new buildings, villager jobs, crafting recipes, crops, and resources. The modding framework even allows you to implement custom player commands and splice completely new progression eras directly into the game's timeline.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're a Catalien. These tourists are your problem.

Holidaze is a chaotic comedy game about guiding the world’s worst tourists through airports, landmarks, souvenir shops, and whatever disaster happens next.

You play as an overworked tour guide trying to keep your travel agency alive. Gather your tourists, lead them through busy locations, get them to photo spots on time, and make sure they spend just enough money before everything falls apart.

Tourists wander off, get distracted, run into trouble, block the way, buy too much junk, lose their belongings, and occasionally make choices that no responsible adult should ever make. Your job is to keep the group moving, keep the ratings high, and somehow get everyone back to the bus before time runs out.

What You'll Do

Use your guide tools to call, stop, carry, throw, and redirect tourists through compact sandbox-style levels. A good guide keeps the group together. A great guide knows when to split them up, block a path, bribe them with snacks, or physically drag them away from a very tempting souvenir shop.

Every tourist has their own problems. Some are slow. Some are too excited. Some love shopping. Some stop for photos. Some attract trouble. Some are simply built to ruin your day.

Keep an eye on the group while dealing with:

  • Tourists wandering away from the route

  • Crowded paths, queues, moving hazards, and blocked passages

  • Photo spots, shops, attractions, and timed objectives

  • Lost valuables, angry staff, security alerts, and other accidents

  • Tourists who are far too interested in cats, food, exhibits, or expensive merchandise

Spend Money to Make Money

A successful trip is not just about survival. Happy tourists leave better tips, shopping tourists bring in more commission, and clean runs help your agency grow.

After each trip, your performance is judged by timing, tourist satisfaction, spending, accidents, complaints, and how many people actually made it back. Use your earnings to buy tools, prepare for harder trips, and take on even more ridiculous tours.

Your company is nearly bankrupt, your customers are impossible, and every new route is more absurd than the last. From airport terminals to crowded tourist streets and famous landmarks, each location brings new hazards, new tourist behaviors, and new ways for a simple group trip to become a complete disaster.

Join the Tour

Holidaze is being actively developed, and player feedback is a huge part of shaping the game. Join the community, share your best disasters, and help decide what kind of tourist nightmare comes next.

store_data.about_the_game:
TERMies Duels turns the word game you already know into a head-to-head fight.

You and an opponent get the same 5-letter word and race to crack it. Solve it first and you yank the rope — landing a pull that drags your rival toward the pit. Keep solving faster than they do and you'll haul the rope all the way across and send them in. Burn all six guesses and you hand them a free pull, so every board is a gamble between speed and certainty. It's Word games brain with a fighting game's heart.

Modes for every mood:

  • Quick Match — jump into a 1v1 against a real opponent.

  • Ranked — climb the termite-caste ladder from Larva to the Apex leaderboard.

  • Vs Bots — Easy, Medium, or Hard practice partners whenever you want.

  • Bracket — 2–8 players, last termite standing.

  • Weekly Words — the classic daily word game, with global standings.

Built for word nerds and trash-talkers alike:

  • A curated pool of 1,000+ answer words and a full dictionary of valid guesses — no repeats within a match.

  • A readable tug-of-war that shows exactly who's winning and how close the pit is.

  • The completed word is revealed after every round, so nobody's left guessing.

  • Cute, bat-wielding termite fighters and a clean, snappy board.

Free to play your way, fair by design — no pay-to-win, ever. Cosmetics only.

store_data.about_the_game:
A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike where you place magical cards on a grid and connect signals.

Reactivate Used Cards

In a typical deckbuilder, cards disappear after being used once. This game is different — cards remain on the board, switching between ON and OFF states, and activate their effects each time they turn back ON from OFF.

If you reactivate the same defense card twice, its defense is applied twice. If you reactivate the same attack card five times, it becomes a five-hit attack.

The true power of your deck is not just how many cards you have, but where you place them and how you turn them back ON.

Send Signals and Connect Chains

When a card turns ON from OFF, it activates its effect and sends signals to nearby cards in the direction of its arrows. A card that receives a signal switches between ON and OFF. Among those cards, only cards that turn ON from OFF activate their effects again and continue sending the next signal.

Turning on just one card in front of you is not enough. Place your cards so that the signal flows from one card to the next, then to the next again, expanding a single activation into a powerful chain. You can create short, reliable chains, or design massive flows that cross the entire board.

Placement Is the True Power of Your Deck

Having powerful cards is not enough.

What matters is reusing the effects you need from the cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks, or prepare the board for your next chain.

Complete Your Own Way of Activating Cards

Gain new cards as you fight, and build a deck with cards that work well together.

You can move the board in many different ways: a deck that repeatedly awakens one key card, a chain deck that activates many cards at once, or a deck that builds up cost and unleashes it all at once. Through choices that change with every run, complete your own chain structure.

Key Features

  • Reusable Cards — Cards do not disappear after being used once. They remain on the board, and whenever a signal turns them back ON from OFF, they activate the same effect again.

  • Signal Chain Design — The path of a signal changes depending on each card’s position and direction. With a single placement, complete a massive chain that crosses the entire board.

  • Effects That Activate When Turned ON — When a card switches from OFF to ON, it activates its unique effect, such as attack, defense, or draw. Which cards you turn back ON, and how many times you do it, determines the outcome of battle.

  • Reusing the Effects You Need — What matters is not creating new effects, but bringing out the effects you need from cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, or trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks.

  • Build Your Own Chain Deck — Gain new cards through battles and build your deck. Move the board in many different ways, such as a deck that repeatedly activates a key card, a chain deck that triggers many cards at once, or a board-building deck that prepares a major activation for the next turn.

HALCYON INDUSTRIES has recently confirmed reports of unexplained phenomena appearing across the world.

Dispatch exploration staff through various routes and review the records they bring back.

Keep the Company Satisfied

Turn the records your employees retrieve into results the company can use.
But be careful. More eyes are watching your work than you may think.

Decide Whose Side You’re On

Does something about the company feel strange to you?
Soon, someone will reach out.

Find your own answer.
