store_data.about_the_game:
“Even when it hurts, even when it breaks you, a magical girl should always smile, right?”

Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game where you reshape a magical barrier to hold back waves of beasts.

Arin is a magical girl in her fourth year on the job, tasked with protecting the mana stones that keep the city’s magical infrastructure running.

Between sleepless shifts and emergency dispatches, she enters the Otherworld, raises her barrier, and fights off the beasts lurking within.

Control the battlefield by reshaping your barrier

Move the vertices of your barrier to expand or shrink your territory.

Attack enemies with mana cannons that travel along the barrier lines.

Expand your territory to secure more resources.

Shrink the barrier to concentrate your firepower in a smaller area.

Keep buffs inside the barrier, and push harmful debuffs out.

You’ll need to keep reshaping your barrier based on the state of the battlefield and the position of nearby resources.

When things get dangerous, stop time, reposition your vertices, and prepare for the next attack.

Add new vertices to strengthen your weapons

Use the mana gained from expanding your barrier to add new vertices.

More vertices allow you to form more complex barrier shapes, increasing your offensive options.

Upgrade your attack power and attack speed, and build the shape and firepower you need for each wave.

Create new builds with modules and enchants

As the story progresses, new modules and enchants will be unlocked.

Equip new attack modules, and use enchants to enhance the traits of your existing ones.

Reshape your barrier around the movement and attack patterns of your modules.

With each wave, the beasts grow stronger. Victory depends on how you shape your barrier and manage your mana.

The story continues after each mission

After each mission, you’ll return to the city and see Arin’s life as a magical girl.

Meet Charlotte, a veteran magical girl; Lily, a girl who admires magical girls; and the people living throughout the city.

As emergency calls keep coming and mysterious disappearances begin to unfold, Arin draws closer to the truth behind mana, magic, and the magical girls themselves.

Key Features

Polygon Defense : A defense system where you directly move vertices to reshape your barrier and control your defensive area.

Module Builds : A build system where modules and enchants change your attack patterns and growth direction.

Magical Girl Narrative : A story centered on Arin, a magical girl worn down by constant dispatches, sleepless shifts, and the burden of always having to smile.

Pixel Art : 2D pixel art visuals depicting both the modern city and the Otherworld beneath its surface.

-------------------------------------------------------------

Log collection is strictly limited to gameplay information for game improvement purposes.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Gray-Crowned Reincarnate is a short isekai fantasy visual novel about Kai, a boy reincarnated from modern Japan, and Lilia, the saint who stands beside him.

Summoned as a hero, Kai is pulled into a kingdom that expects salvation, a prophecy that hides too much, and the shadow of Demon King Valdros. A sealed sword whispers of black power, and every choice asks what kind of hero he will become.

The story unfolds across 15 illustrated scenes and branches into four endings: become the Demon King, defeat the Demon King, run away with Lilia, or fail and watch the world fall into ruin.

Features

- A compact fantasy visual novel built around dramatic choices

- 15 anime-style scene illustrations with a bright 1980s-inspired fantasy mood

- 4 endings, from heroic victory to tragic collapse

- Kai, Lilia, and Valdros at the center of an isekai story about duty, escape, corruption, and salvation

- Instrumental background music prepared for each scene

- Text support for Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian

Choose the crown you will carry.

store_data.about_the_game:
Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological sci-fi horror game where exploration, investigation, and environmental puzzles are woven into a dark and immersive narrative.

After losing contact with his wife during an expedition, Adam Lorn embarks on a desperate search for answers within a colossal abandoned alien complex. As he ventures deeper, he uncovers the remnants of the ancient Grak'Tal civilization and realizes that something sinister still lurks within, distorting reality and slowly consuming his sanity.

Features

Explore an Alien Complex

Venture through laboratories, industrial facilities, and monumental structures built by the Grak'Tal. Discover forgotten documents, hidden records, and long-buried secrets scattered throughout a mysterious interconnected environment.

Decipher the Grak'Tal Logs

The records left behind by the Grak'Tal civilization are written in their own alien language.

Use a mysterious demonic translator to decipher these documents and uncover crucial information about the complex and its inhabitants.

But beware: every translation increases your corruption.

Corruption System

Each time the translator is used, Adam becomes more corrupted.

As corruption grows, reality itself begins to change. Supernatural phenomena become more frequent, the environment grows increasingly distorted, and exploration presents new challenges and opportunities.

Spectral Rush

Temporarily leave your physical body behind using the Spectral Rush ability.

Pass through certain barriers and possess inactive robots to activate machinery, solve puzzles, and access otherwise unreachable areas.

Environmental Puzzles

Gather clues throughout your exploration, interact with alien technology, and make use of your unique abilities to overcome obstacles and unlock new paths.

Psychological Horror

Blame Echoes delivers an oppressive and immersive psychological horror experience through atmospheric world design, dynamic lighting, environmental storytelling, and the constant feeling that something is always watching you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hey Dad, 

I’ve made a game that I’d like you to play. It’s hopefully not too difficult for you to get through and while you may get a tad lost at times, I’m hoping the path forward should be relatively clear once you find it. 

I don’t quite know how best to explain what the game is about, the game says it much better than I could here in this letter, but to put it broadly…

It’s about you and me. 

Anyway, uh…

Let me know what you think when you reach the end.

 -  Junebug

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

‘The Walks We Used To Take’ is a semi-autobiographical game by Junebug about their relationship with their father and the walks they used to take together. Walk through a landscape of metaphor while listening to voice messages discovered scattered along the way: voice messages recorded by Junebug for their father, attempting to convey a difficult but important truth.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Synopsis

Arnaud just wants to be left alone.

Turned into a vampire against his will long ago, he's nonetheless managed to carve out a largely peaceful existence in an abandoned manor—a peaceful existence routinely interrupted by the vampire hunter Julien, seeking blood for blood.

Over the years, animosity has morphed into a strange sort of respect, and on one stormy night, Arnaud is greeted with a sight he never expected: his mortal enemy Julien, gravely injured on his doorstep.

Will Arnaud take him in, or will he use this opportunity to grasp the peace he's been seeking for years?

Bonded in Darkness is a free gothic BL romance visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning how to trust each other.

Features

  • ~9.4k words (45 minutes-1 hour to read all endings)

  • Story dealing with themes of trust, isolation, and asexuality

  • Font selection (Source Serif, Sylexiad Serif, Atkinson Hyperlegible)

store_data.about_the_game:
Will you be able to survive the descent? Follow Theo, a ball-like creature, and his group of kid friends as they explore the colossal world-tree that has grown to occupy most of the world through a series of challenges that will test not only their survival skills, but also their own sanity.

Most of the game will be formed in a Visual Novel style, but Theo will have to make difficult choices to be able to save everybody. Theo's group's main resource will be their fear. Too much of it, and they'll succumb to the dangers, too little, and they'll rush into it head-on. Try to mantain a balance by navigating the various challenges, and talk to your friends to mantain the harmony in their group. Will everybody survive? That depends solely on you.

Not even Victor, the most intelligent in the group, knows what hides at the bottom of the tree. How will they return home? What awaits them on the tree itself? Find out this and much more in "Seeds of Pain", a story about survival, pain, and maybe just a bit of hope.

store_data.about_the_game:
You Are Never Alone.

EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana is a psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, and senses your fear, reacting to your actions in real time. Forget predictable jumpscares.

PRESENCE SYSTEM

Every sound has a source.

If you hear a bottle shatter...

it's because the demon actually threw it.

If you hear footsteps...

someone is walking through the apartment.

If you find a message written on the wall...

the demon has just written it.

The world reveals its presence.

Lights.

Whispers.

Shadows.

Anomalies.

Knocking.

Doors.

You never know what will happen next.

THE DEMON FIGHTS BACK

The demon watches your every move.

It hears every sound you make.

It remembers your actions.

It reacts to the progress of the ritual.

It becomes more aggressive over time.

It can turn off the lights.

It can throw objects.

It can reveal itself for only a second.

It can watch you from the darkness.

It can write messages on the walls.

It can strike when you least expect it.

This isn't a series of scripted animations.

The demon decides when to scare you.

A REAL EXORCISM RITUAL

Take on the role of a priest's assistant and participate in a terrifying exorcism ritual.

Document the entire ritual using a voice recorder.

Assist the priest.

Place candles.

Recite prayers.

Complete ritual-related tasks.

Witness the growing signs of possession.

In the final confrontation, use the cross, holy water, and prayers to face the demon.

POSSESSION

Throughout the ritual, you watch over the possessed victim.

The closer you get to the end...

the more the victim changes...

and so does the apartment.

The line between reality and hell slowly begins to disappear.


3D JUMPSCARE

A special 3D Jumpscare effect makes demons appear as if they are literally bursting out of your monitor.

No VR headset.

No glasses.

Just you...

and the demon on the other side of the screen.

FEATURES

  • Presence System that reacts to the player in real time.

  • Every sound is the result of the demon physically interacting with the environment.

  • Unpredictable paranormal manifestations.

  • 3D Jumpscare effect without VR or special glasses.

  • Document the exorcism using a voice recorder.

  • Perform realistic tasks inspired by real exorcism rituals.

  • Fight the demon using a crucifix, holy water, and prayers.

  • Possession evolves as the ritual progresses.

  • A dark Eastern European apartment inspired by late 80s and 90s architecture.

  • Full Gamepad Support.

  • Steam Achievements.

  • Steam Cloud.

  • Graphics Settings.

  • Windows, Linux and macOS support.

  • 175 language localizations.

  • Voice Over for selected languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
You don't place towers. You program them.

Compile & Defend is a tower defense game with no click-to-shoot. Every tower on the field runs your code, once per tick. Write a smarter script and your defense gets smarter — write a sloppy one and the swarm walks right through.

It's the tower defense game for people who'd rather refactor than micromanage.

Write it in your language

There's no proprietary scripting dialect to learn. You write in a clean subset of a real language you already know — pick from Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, Rust, Zig, or Lua. They all compile to the same engine; the language only changes how your code is spelled. Switch anytime.

How it plays

Your program is bound to each tower every tick — me is the tower, me.enemies_in_range is what it can see, me.shoot(target) pulls the trigger. From there it's all you!

The closest enemy isn't always the most dangerous one — so the naive shoot the first thing you see script will always get you started, and never win. Better algorithms beat more towers.

Features

  • Code-driven combat — a real (but safe) interpreter runs your script. Clear, line-numbered errors, because debugging is half the genre.
  • A teaching campaign — a seven-stage tutorial walks you from your first shoot to full for-loop swarm control, introducing each threat one step before the tool that beats it.
  • 13 campaign maps across three tiers.
  • Easy / Normal / Hard — harder modes are tougher and longer, pushing you into scaled freeplay for the medal. Earn up to three stars per map, including a bespoke coding challenge that rewards a genuinely better algorithm, not just more gold.
  • Ten distinct towers — Arrow, Cannon, Tesla, Sniper, Frost, Venom, Support, Mortar, Chain and Detect, each with its own API: slow enemies, poison them, buff allies, lob splash at a point, chain lightning through a cluster, or reveal camo for your other towers.
  • Eight threats to route around — fast Runners, flying Flyers, armored Brutes, camo Shades, swarming Spawnlings, self-splitting Broods, and the nested Titan boss.
  • Build and share your own levels — draw a map, draft its waves, and share it with a single copy-paste code. An auto-balancer certifies every level is beatable and code-mandatory before you play.
  • Sandbox mode — infinite gold, every enemy on tap, hot-swap your code live. Prototype a controller, break it, fix it.

Everything is deterministic, so a script that wins today wins tomorrow.

Write once. Compile. Defend.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hatch'n'Wall is a digital turn-based medieval board game.

A bit of lore...

The King is dead, and his heirs now fight over the kingdom's throne.

Champion! You have been chosen by your prince to recover the royal crown hidden deep within the castle. But Beware: other champions are also racing to seize it before you. In this maze of shifting walls and treacherous hatches, use the castle's traps to block your opponents, foil their plans, and be the first to escape with the royal crown!

Game Features

  • Up to 4 knights face off in a castle. Be the unique Champion!

  • At the start of the game, each player draws a Contact Card and keeps it secret until reaching the corresponding tile. They then obtain a key, granting access to the Treasure Room, where they collect a treasure and draw a Secret Exit Card. No one knows your plan until you make your move. Bluffing is half the battle.

  • Two dice per turn — one for movement, one for action. Every roll brings you closer to your goal while sabotaging your rival.

  • 4 actions possible: build walls, trigger hatches, destroy obstacles, or use ladders. Control the maze, control the game.

  • The board is procedurally generated every game — contacts, traps and cards are shuffled each time. No two games are ever the same.

  • Want to tease your rivals? A taunt wheel is available. 

  • Play against friends in local hot seat or online multiplayer via Steam, or sharpen your tactics against AI opponents with three difficulty levels.

Think. Trap. Escape.

Will you be the first to break through the walls, outsmart the traps, and escape with the treasure?

“20 years ago, my father-in-law invented this board game and built it by hand, in wood. We could not produce it physically… so I turned it into a video game.”

— Original concept by "Boldectotor" · Video game adaptation by "Cpt.Jhon.H.Miller"

store_data.about_the_game:
The Reach does not forgive. It rewards those who endure.

Grim Reach is a dark-fantasy idle RPG about carving a life out of a dying land. You arrive with nothing but calloused hands, and the world expects you to earn everything else. So you fell blackened trees and haul ore from cold mines; you smelt, cook, brew and stitch; you learn the patient trades that keep a body alive out here. Every craft feeds another, and one log, one ingot, one rune at a time, you become something the wilds have to reckon with.

Then you take up a weapon and walk into the dark. Combat is relentless and automatic, but never mindless: melee, ranged and magic each fight to their own rhythm, and the horrors of the Reach hit back hard. Survival is a matter of preparation. Plate to soak the blows, leather to slip them, cloth wards to swallow what is left, and enough food and drink in your pack to outlast the fight. Come undergeared, and the Reach will teach you why armor is not optional.

What keeps you here is the climb. Enchant your gear with tiered runes, gamble on random suffixes, and chase the rare drops that rewrite an entire build. Track every foe in a growing bestiary, take Slayer contracts for loot no ordinary kill will yield, and craft the equipment a stingy world refuses to hand you. There is always a deeper vein, a sharper blade, an enemy you could not have touched a week ago.

And it never sleeps. Your skills rise while you play and keep rising while you are away. Auto-battle, auto-eat and offline progress mean the Reach grows in the dark, ready for you when you return.

Play in seven languages: English, Deutsch, 简体中文, Русский, Español, Português (BR) and Français.

store_data.about_the_game:
MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world.

Set in the year 2125, AI has optimized everything—labor, taxation, romance, emotions, even the choices that shape the future. In this world, even "loving what you love" is considered a crime.

Alongside girls whose humanity has been classified as a crime, the player infiltrates a digital world governed by AI-enforced laws. Through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten. Narrative sequences intertwine with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized to vocal performances, transforming music itself into the power of hacking.

This is the girls' hack—a rebellion against a future that has become too perfect.

store_data.about_the_game:
FORTARO is a physics-driven roguelike where every spin earns new upgrades, every upgrade reshapes your run, and every run becomes an entirely money-making experience.


Every run begins the same: a tiny, weak wheel, a handful of spins, and just enough cash to get started. Fast-forward a few rounds, and you’ll be watching a custom-built engine unleash ridiculous, million-dollar combos.

 

Reach your goal before you run out of spins. Buy powerful new segments, get rid of the bad ones, duplicate your favorites - all within a shop. Will you play it safe, or risk it all on a high-stakes synergy? One perfect hit can spark the ultimate comeback.

Design ultimate chain reactions where one segment triggers the next, and the next... until your entire wheel comes alive. In FORTARO, the strongest builds aren’t planned - they’re discovered in the chaos.

Your wheel is just the foundation. Uncover game-changing Artifacts, upgrade your Pegs, and adapt to shifting Shop Inventories. Face off against ruthless Bosses that twist the rules of the game, then use your rewards to build something even crazier.

  • Build the Wheel: Customize your own physics-driven Wheel of Fortune from scratch.

  • Infinite Synergies: Discover broken interactions between dozens of unique wheel segments.

  • Adapt or Die: Constantly pivot your strategy through dynamic shops and random upgrades.

  • Massive Variety: Collect hundreds of unique segments, artifacts, and peg upgrades.

  • Rule-Bending Bosses: Test your engine against bosses with mechanics designed to shut you down.

  • Unstoppable Scaling: Watch your humble starting wheel evolve into an absurd, money-printing machine.

P.S. FORTARO is a strategy roguelike designed to be broken, not a real money machine. No real money, no real odds, NO GAMBLING, just chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Break rocks. Grow stronger. Rise to become King of the Xantul.

Goguz is no king — not yet. But every day, he sets out across a bright, hand-drawn cartoon world with one mission: find the perfect precious stone for his queen. Explore colorful biomes, smash everything in your path, and pour your rewards into a vast web of skill trees. Little by little, Goguz grows — bigger, stronger, until he towers over the world as the true King of the Xantul.

Pebble for a Queen is an exploration adventure with the deep, ever-climbing progression of a true incremental.

A run a day

Each day is a fresh expedition. Roam vibrant biomes, break rocks, gather resources, and take on whatever stands between you and the perfect stone. When night falls, invest everything you've earned — then wake up stronger and push even further.

Over 1,500 nodes — and every choice matters

Progression runs deep. Spend five distinct resources across multiple sprawling skill trees, including four dedicated elemental trees. This isn't mindless unlocking: your choices carry real weight. Build smart, specialize with purpose, and a well-planned path will make you far more powerful than a careless one. There's always another node, another milestone, another goal just ahead.

Master the Elemental Tails

Goguz is no ordinary Xantul. Wield a collection of elemental tails, each with its own flavor and playstyle, and mix and match them to shape how you explore and break your way through the world. Finding the right combination is half the fun.

Quests that give it all meaning

This is no mindless number-cruncher. A thread of quests and challenges runs through the entire adventure, guiding your journey and giving every step a purpose. Some gate your progress entirely — rise to the challenge and prove yourself before the next tier of upgrades is yours. Every milestone is earned, never handed to you.

Become the King

This is a journey of transformation. As Goguz grows through the adventure, he changes — rising from a humble Xantul to a colossal ruler. The path to becoming king is yours to carve.

A hand-drawn cartoon world

Bright, bold, and full of character — every creature and every corner is hand-drawn in a classic cartoon style, full of light-hearted charm and a joy to explore.

The end is only the beginning

Reaching the end of the journey unlocks something more — a hidden challenge for those who want to test everything they've learned. What it asks of you, and what it holds, is yours to discover.

Set in the Sunrohc universe — a growing world of games from Mangus.

store_data.about_the_game:
No Exit Protocol is a psychological horror game where you wake up trapped in an endless maze with no memory of how you got there. Starting in the familiar yellow halls of Level 0, you must explore, survive, and search for a way forward. Every corridor feels the same, every turn could lead somewhere new, and something may be watching from beyond the walls.

Find the route to the next area, a cold and unsettling level filled with asphalt floors and concrete walls. But escaping one level only leads deeper into the unknown. As you progress, the environment becomes stranger, the atmosphere grows heavier, and the truth behind your situation remains hidden.

Can you keep moving forward, or will the Backrooms claim you forever?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome aboard the final subway train of the night.

You are the driver, and every station brings the same responsibility: inspect the platform, observe the passengers, and decide whether it is safe to open the doors.

Most stops seem ordinary.

Some are not.

Study the station from the driver's cabin and security cameras. Look for unusual passengers, suspicious behavior, environmental anomalies, and anything that feels out of place.

Your task is simple:

If the station is safe, open the doors.

If something is wrong, bypass the station.

But every decision has consequences. Opening the doors to the wrong passengers may put everyone on board at risk, while repeatedly leaving legitimate passengers behind will attract the attention of your employer.

Follow procedure. Stay on schedule. Trust your judgment.

The train must keep moving.

store_data.about_the_game:
As a team of up to four blacksmiths, your goal in Anvil United! is to forge and craft medieval weaponry with speed and precision. To pursue your goal, you need to know the recipes, plan your strategy, cooperate and swiftly respond to events taking place around you.

Gather crafting materials, take advantage of crafting stations, work with your team and avoid obstacles such as meteors from up above, fires spreading across your stations, slippery floor and cheeky goblins.

Your production pipeline will be disrupted not only by randomized obstacles but by potential extra rewards and bonuses in the shape of magical treasure chests.

With every new obstacle comes a new bonus for you to unlock and take advantage in future playthroughs of Anvil United!.

Anvil United! introduces quick and satisfying play sessions for up to four people in offline mode. The game takes advantage of controllers and allows for seamless gameplay.

Once you unlock all the levels and bonuses you can play each level in an endless mode, with each additional minute making the game more and more challenging.

The game is divided into 20 separate levels across four settings: dark dungeons, freezing north, kings kingdom (duh!) and far east.

Each new level introduces new recipes for crafting items, new environmental challenges, a new layout and new bonus to unlock. This way a single level becomes a game on its own which you can replay to improve your score and unlock achievements as many times as you like.

Anvil United! allows you to customize your character in a limited matter so you always know where your character is when all chaos breaks loose.

Complete levels, gather stars, improve your score and unlock a gallery of hats for your blacksmith to wear.

  • single and multiplayer

  • offline co-op play for up to 4 players

  • intuitive controls and fast paced gameplay

  • 20 colorful levels to explore

  • numerous medieval weapons to craft

  • more than 20 bonuses to unlock and modify the gameplay with

  • Steam Achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
不思議な箱庭をめぐる、3Dのアドベンチャーゲームです。

これはなに？

2021年にPC用フリーウェアとして公開されたゲームです。

夢の中に迷い込んだプレイヤーを操作し現実を目指します。

箱庭世界をさまよいながらテキストを読んで話を進めます。

Steamにて配信するにあたり少しだけ調整していますが、

・非圧縮で保存されていた音声ファイルを適切に圧縮

・テキストが読みやすくなるようフォントを変更

・タイトル画面へ戻る隠しコマンドを追加

など、必要最低限にとどめています。

稚拙さ　未熟さ　ぎこちなさ　そのままにしてあります。

故にフリーウェアです。

操作について

キーボードの場合

移動・・・・・・・・WASD / 方向キー

ダッシュ・・・・・・Shift（移動中）

話す・決定・・・・・Enter / Z / スペースキー

キャンセル・・・・・Esc / X

フルスクリーン・・・F4

XInputに対応したコントローラーを使用できます。

タイトル画面へ戻るには

Shift + Z + X を長押ししてください。（コントローラーの場合は X + A + B 長押し）

（イベント中にこのコマンドを入力した場合はイベントが終わってからタイトルに戻ります。）

（ダッシュ・決定・キャンセル の組み合わせであれば、どのキーを押してもコマンドが発動します。）

store_data.about_the_game: 《Drift of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，聚焦于战斗中的位置推移与节奏漂移。玩家将在一个可感知行动序列漂变的环境中，根据战局流动判断何时顺势推进、何时逆向牵制，在动态变化的行动关系里维持对战斗的主导权。每一场战斗中，敌我双方的行动排序并非完全固定，小幅度漂移会不断改变攻防时机。玩家需要结合技能的前置条件与后置效果，在“当前可行”与“下一轮可能”之间做出取舍，让队伍始终在漂移中保有可控的输出窗口。不同敌人组合会制造不同方向的关系拉扯，迫使玩家重新理解每一次行动顺序的价值。随着流程推进，角色将获得调整行动权重与影响序列漂移幅度的能力，使玩家在面对更复杂的战斗关系时拥有更精细的干预手段。整体体验强调在不稳定的行动流中识别节奏、利用漂移，而非追求绝对固定的最优顺序。《Drift of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 但渴望感受行动次序流动感的玩家，提供一段以节奏漂移感知与序列掌控为核心的单人体验，在连续对抗中走完一条始终轻微晃动却始终可驾驭的冒险之路。

store_data.about_the_game:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! In The Legend Of Fireball, you begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Home appliances, computers, motorcycles, cars, massive buildings - every target brings you closer to true fireball mastery.

BURN THROUGH BIGGER AND TOUGHER TARGETS
Grow stronger, upgrade your stats, and take on bigger, tougher, and crazier targets. Boost your Fireball Power, Stamina, Stamina Recovery, and more to turn every shot into pure destruction. When you are ready, enter special challenges with a target and a time limit. Destroy the required number of objects before the countdown ends to earn rewards and unlock the next stage!

MORE POWER WITH EVERY UPGRADE
Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

COMMAND YOUR PET COMPANIONS
Create a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills. Bring up to 3 pets into action and let them attack alongside you while boosting your power. Their skills add another layer of strength to every stage, turning your fireball training into a true team effort.

Features:

• Fireball Action - Aim, charge, and launch explosive fireball attacks!
• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger
• Stylish Costumes - Wear costumes to boost your Stamina and Stamina Recovery
• Powerful Relics - Collect relics to gain stat boosts for Fireball Power, Stamina, Gold, Exp, and others
• Pet Companions - Build a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills
• Timed Challenges - Destroy the required number of targets before the countdown ends to unlock the next stage
• Daily Missions and Achievements - Complete tasks and claim extra rewards
• Special Events - Break the Gold Safe for coins and enter the World Championship to win gems
• Addictive Progression - Keep upgrading, unlocking, and destroying bigger targets

End as the legend who can destroy anything!

store_data.about_the_game:
Mors: Idle Reaper is a dark idle/incremental RPG where you gather resources, forge your power, and fight an endless ladder of enemies — all rendered in a retro CRT-terminal aesthetic.

FIGHT AND GROW

Battle enemies that scale with your level. Every 30 levels a Boss appears with higher damage and armor-piercing attacks. Rare Elite enemies drop Shards, a special meta-currency. Build your combat stats: damage, defense, crit chance, crit damage, attack speed, lifesteal, thorns, execute damage and more.

GATHER SEVEN RESOURCES

Wood, Stone, Iron, Obsidian, Bloodstone, Mana and Soul — each with its own upgrade tree of 15+ passive generators and tap upgrades. Resources keep accumulating even while you are offline.

REBIRTH AND GET PERMANENTLY STRONGER

Reset your run to earn Skill Points and a permanent multiplier to both your resources and your combat power. Spend points in the Rebirth Tree (15 skills), unlock new systems with each milestone: Quests, Zones, Relics, Magic, the Shard Shop, Boss Chests, Weekly Challenges and more.

LOOT AND EQUIPMENT

Bosses drop items across rarity tiers up to Legendary. Collect relics with set bonuses, forge swords and armor in the Armory, and equip gear with unique affixes.

AND THEN... AMO

At level 1000 you will meet Amo. You cannot flee. You cannot close the game to escape. You either defeat it — or surrender. Good luck.

FEATURES

  • 100+ hours of progression for players who want to see it through to the end

  • Idle/incremental progression with active combat

  • 5 zones with mastery stars and scaling rewards

  • Daily & weekly quests, daily streak rewards

  • Offline progress (expandable up to 24h+)

  • Full save system with backups and corruption recovery

  • Optional CRT filter and epilepsy-safe mode

  • Supports English, 简体中文, Deutsch, Français, Русский

store_data.about_the_game:
Every sorcerer knows the true secret of magic: numbers. In Wizard's Calc, each round hands you a target number and a challenge that's simple to state but addictive to solve — reach it by chaining arithmetic spells.

You set a base number and conjure fire operations (add and multiply) and ice operations (subtract and divide) until you hit the exact target. Sounds easy? Some digits are locked every round, forcing you to find the path no one else can see. And the clock never stops ticking.



Master two elements
Fire grows, ice cuts. Learning when to burn and when to freeze — and in what order — is the difference between an easy win and a total that falls short by a single digit.



The great numbers hold a secret
They say that when the targets grow beyond counting, the magic becomes more forgiving. Get close enough and the spell recognizes your intent — for no wizard should lose their sanity chasing the last digit of a colossal number. Come near enough, and the void does the rest.



Face bosses that break the rules
Just when you think you've got the hang of it, bosses arrive to flip the board: they hide the preview, disable operations, double or halve your values. Each one demands a new way of thinking. Adapt, or start over from scratch.


Shape every run in the Magic Shop
Between rounds, spend your points in a shop full of consumable items and equippable passives. Gain time, ignore locked digits, multiply your score, force the target to shift — no run is ever the same as the last.


Climb ten levels of rising difficulty
From a gentle first sum to the final level, which demands 35 wins under relentless pressure. Each unlocked level adds new rules and twists to the formula.


Play your way
An interactive tutorial teaches every mechanic at your own pace, and Sandbox Mode unlocks all the rules for you to experiment: fixed target, win goal, time, starting points and bosses, all fully configurable.

Secrets carved into the arrows — There’s an ancient enchantment no manual will teach you. They say it answers to a simple cadence of up, down, and sides… and that it reveals bonus stages to those with the patience to uncover it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Start with a pickaxe. End with a fully automated industrial empire.

Oreworks is a relaxing incremental game where every major milestone unlocks an entirely new way to play.

Begin by mining ore, smelting ingots, crafting components, and upgrading your equipment. As your operation grows, you'll unlock new gameplay systems that expand your industrial network and introduce fresh mechanics.

Unlike many incremental games, Oreworks doesn't simply increase the numbers—it continuously introduces new activities while keeping every previous system relevant.

Over time, manual actions become fully automated, allowing you to focus on optimizing your ever-growing industrial complex.

Whether you're managing passive mines, trading resources, upgrading casino machines, defeating powerful guardians, or coordinating factory drones, every system contributes to the same interconnected progression.

Relax, optimize, automate, and transform a humble mine into a thriving industrial empire.

Total Relaxation: No stress or deadlines. Just enjoy the atmosphere of a forest paradise and feel like a real lemon among the moss and ferns.

Beautiful Visuals: The game is permeated with soft sunlight filtering through the treetops, with reflections in the water and detailed forest vegetation.

Chilling Soundtrack: The sounds of the forest—the babbling river, birdsong, and rustling leaves—are complemented by specially selected calm music for deep relaxation.

Simplicity and Zen: This is the perfect simulator for those seeking peace and meditation in games. Observe life around you, and let the world revolve.

Are you ready to become a lemon in this fairytale forest?

store_data.about_the_game:
What if every powerful tower was also a danger?

Elementis TD is a solo, tense elemental tower defense built around one dilemma: your most devastating towers feed the Corruption... which empowers your enemies. Fuse elements, free the kingdoms, and read the corruption map on every wave. 100% solo, 100% strategy.

☠ The Corruption dilemma — your strategic signature

Corrupting towers (Fire, Lightning, Granite, Frost, Sniper) hit hardest, but raise Corruption — enemy HP and speed climb. Pure towers cleanse it. Lean into the dark path for raw power, or hold the balance? No tower placement is ever "free".

⚗ Fuse the elements — hundreds of builds

8 base towers → 21 fusions + 5 ultimate mega-fusions + 16 specializations. Place two compatible towers side by side, fuse them, specialize. Every combination unlocks effects impossible otherwise.

⚔ Narrative campaign — 7 corrupted kingdoms

From the Cursed Crypt to the Void: 7 kingdoms, 7 bosses, 7 Nexum fragments to reclaim. Intro and ending cinematics, lore that unfolds wave after wave. A real story behind the towers.

♾ Eternal Vigil — endless roguelite mode

Finish the campaign to awaken the Infinite Run: monthly labyrinth, endless waves, milestones, leaderboards. Difficulty climbs to the impossible. How far will you last?

🦸 7 heroes to earn — not to buy

Two starting heroes, five more to unlock by playing their element (freeze, poison, shock, fuse...). Each has a unique passive that reshapes your build.

✦ And more

  • Monthly Challenge (shared seed) + achievements

  • 100% procedural audio, unique atmosphere per kingdom

  • Special towers, relics, between-wave shop, interest-based economy

  • Multilingual French / English / German / Russian — Controller: no (mouse/keyboard)

One Guardian. Seven kingdoms. A corruption that never sleeps.

BDC

store_data.about_the_game:
In Business jet tycoon you run and manage fleets of private jets for clients. Build airports, design interiors and set your markup.

The games business engine uses real world values adjusted for inflation and historic jet fuel prices over the decades.

Business jets can serve clients 800 hours a year. Broken up into 32 cards offering 25 hours each they can be sold to clients. The hours on the cards can be used by the clients as they wish. A jet from a fleet of identical jets is made available.

Highly researched. Play from 1980-2025 with a wide range of historic models which follow historic trends over the decades.

Documentary sections to give you an idea of how history is affecting the business jet market. From the end of the cold war to the 2008 financial crash. Try to make a business that can thrive in any decade.

store_data.about_the_game:
Will you clock out in one piece tonight...?

A convenience store night shift with unusually good pay. At first, you thought you'd lucked into a great part-time job. But nights at SHIFT24, a mysterious convenience store chain, are anything but ordinary.

Fight Off Endless Waves of Bizarre Customers

The later it gets, the stranger they become. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, grow stronger, and take down the boss waiting at the end of each shift.

Work Night Shifts Around the World

Each SHIFT24 branch brings new customers, new challenges, and new secrets. From Seoul to Texas to Sapporo, every location offers a different fight.

Everything in the Store Is a Weapon

From ramen and snacks to coffee and hot dogs, anything you can grab becomes a weapon. Collect Soul Flames dropped by defeated customers to level up, choose new weapons and upgrades, and build a powerful arsenal with every run.

Uncover the Truth Behind SHIFT24

Suspicious clues are hidden across SHIFT24 branches around the world. After each shift, the owner reveals a little more, and the scattered pieces slowly come together.

Pay Off Your Debt. Choose Your Ending.

How much debt you repay and how many clues you collect will determine which ending awaits you. Will you escape SHIFT24, or become part of it?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Medovox — a sandbox life simulator where nature and agriculture intertwine into a single ecosystem. The protagonist, Max, relied on hired workers for a long time to handle all the routine, but now financial resources are limited. It's time to take everything under personal control! Feel the rush of new motivation, roll up your sleeves, and start managing your thriving homestead on your own. Your adventure begins in a warm, incredibly beautiful autumn — the perfect time for a deep cleanup, harvesting, and preparing for new challenges.

Explore, Create, Live The game world is crafted in a unique geometric low-poly style. This is not just a farm, but a living, stylized universe. Complete engaging quests, tidy up your land, and get ready for amazing adventures as you explore the surrounding world.

Key Features:

  • Deep Immersion: A first-person experience with a realistic day-night cycle. Watch sunrises turn into sunsets brought to life by your farm's detailed local lighting.

  • Sandbox Freedom: Start with basic tasks and cleanup to unlock building elements in the future. Visually customize your farm, place objects, and create coziness on your own terms.

  • A Living Open World: The map is full of secrets. Venture beyond the farm: gather mushrooms in the forest, find hidden easter eggs, and observe wild animals.

  • Sounds Like Life: Feel the atmosphere with high-quality Ukrainian voice acting (work on dubbing in other languages, including English, is already underway!).

  • Play in Your Native Language: Medovox's interface is localized into more than 20 languages right at launch.

Medovox is constantly evolving! We are at the very beginning of our journey and plan to expand the mechanics, adding new features together with our community.

Use your metal detector to search the island and follow the signal to hidden finds.

Mark the spot, grab your shovel, and uncover buried chests and forgotten items.

Search your discoveries and collect valuable loot, rare parts, and mysterious relics.

Visit the trader, sell your finds, and turn buried findings into real profit.

Explore the island together, share discoveries, and hunt  for treasure in co-op.

Unlock new areas with different treasures, rare loot pools, and better opportunities.

Improve your detector, shovel, backpack, and gear to reach better rewards.

Help island NPCs, deliver requested items and earn money, rewards, and progression.

Combine broken parts and old fragments into more valuable items at your workbench.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Boulder House

You wake up trapped in a sprawling mansion filled with gym gear, protein shakes, and locked doors. Monitoring the halls is Chrissy, a paranoid, hyper-muscled parody who patrols the house looking for intruders. Your goal is simple: find the tools, solve the locks, and get out.

5 Spanks and You're Out

Every time Chrissy catches you, he gives you an unforgettable, humiliating spanking with a massive wooden paddle. You wake up on the next day with the house reset, but the clock is ticking. You have exactly 5 attempts to escape before he finally loses his patience and ends your run for good.

Watch the Cameras (But Don't Get Greedy)

You have access to a security monitor to track Chrissy’s movements. Use it to map his patrol routes and plan your next move. But beware: Chrissy hates technology. Stare at the monitors for too long, and he will track your signal, enter a blind rage, and hunt you down instantly.

Infinite Replayability & Challenge

No two runs are the same. Every time you get a full game over (after 5 failed attempts), all puzzle items randomize into completely new locations. Choose from multiple difficulty modes to test your stealth skills, speedrun your escape, or turn the mansion into an absolute nightmare.

Key Features:

  • Caseoh Friendly: Kindergarten level puzz-"activities" to escape.

  • Classic Escape Gameplay: Scavenge for keys, fuses, and strange tools to unlock your path to freedom.

  • 5-Day Life System: Balance your risks carefully—you only get 5 attempts per run.

  • Randomized Spawns: Item locations fully reshuffle on every fresh reset to keep you guessing.

  • Risk vs. Reward Tracking: Balance your camera usage to stay safe without triggering Chrissy's aggro state.

  • Multiple Difficulties: Adjust Chrissy's speed, aggression, and hearing to match your playstyle.

An upcoming Granny-like game made for Caseoh. 

"Why can't Chris Redfield just be in here walking around in just a maid outfit with bunny ears on, with a paddle, and every time I get too loud, he just beats me?" - Caseoh

This is my first real game, I hope you have fun :)

store_data.about_the_game:
You start with an empty store, $1,000, and a computer in the backroom. That's it.

Order your first shipment, haul the box out, and stock the shelf yourself. A customer walks in, grabs what they need, and checks out at your register. That's the loop — and it's more satisfying than it has any right to be.

Everything is hands-on. You carry the delivery boxes, you open them, you decide what goes where. Place your shelves, rotate them how you like, set your prices, and see what sells. The store looks exactly how you built it — because you did build it.

The product catalog runs from cheap refurbished golf balls all the way up to premium Titleridge iron sets and drivers. You won't have access to everything on day one — you'll earn it as your store grows and your level climbs.

There's no handholding here. Understock and customers leave empty handed. Overprice and they walk. Find the balance, grow your margins, and reinvest.

It's a golf superstore. Run it like one.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

The Enclave — the last fortified settlement, built from the ruins of a megacity after the Awakening War. Fifty years ago, humanity paid an unthinkable price to silence the Core — the central machine intelligence that nearly wiped humankind off the face of the earth. You grew up after the war. You know it only from the stories of the elders and the lessons taught in the bunker-school.
Then one of the Core's dormant nodes begins to wake.
You're a trainee cartographer, granted access to the Dead Zone scouting parties for the first time. Every expedition draws you closer to those who survived the war, or grew up in its shadow — to their fears, their secrets, and the things they hide even from themselves. Trust builds slowly: around a fire after a dangerous night, in the silence between two words, in the choice to stay close when it would be easier to walk away.
The closer the Core comes to waking, the clearer one thing becomes: the battle fought fifty years ago never ended. It was only waiting — for someone willing to get close enough, and to trust enough, not to face what comes next alone, when the time comes to choose between the weapon and the word.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

- Multiple story routes, each with its own endings and its own explicit scenes.
- Choices with no hints: trust is built from small moments, and it decides who survives the final assault.
- 18+ content woven into the story itself: tension, intimacy, and the price both of you pay for it.
- A mystery behind the Core's awakening, and a final battle where you'll have to choose between the weapon and the word.

Identify terrain you see—are they land, clouds, or icebergs, or something else?

Chart novel routes through the sea to acquire rare goods, then jealously guard these routes from pirates and raiders.

Shape Global History

Who you chose to trade with and what you choose to give them shape what they will invent or who they will meet. 

Fake Discoveries

History is full of explorers who falsified discoveries to manipulate patrons and receive patronage, why not join their ranks?

Write Your Legacy

Experience the emergent narrative that happens as the result of your choices throughout the game.

UNSCREW, CLEAN, AND REPAIR

  • Click&Fix is a small incremental game where you repair consoles to save your best friend... while making a looooot of money along the way.

  • Unlock a big selection of consoles. Each new model is harder to repair, but also more profitable to sell.

  • Make use of a wide range of tools, machines, and upgrades to make your job easier. Your greatest allies are your automatic screwdriver, your brush, and Robotin, your repair assistant.

WATCH OUT FOR EVIL CONSOLES!

  • Face off against rogue consoles with a mind of their own that refuse to be repaired. One of them is responsible for your friend's disappearance.

  • Earn Research Points to unlock permanent upgrades between runs, including Robotin's advanced upgrade tree and the chance to find rare shiny consoles that sell for even more.

FEATURES & DEVELOPER

  • Hi! I'm the creator of Infiniclick, and this is my latest incremental game.

  • A short console repair adventure, lasting around 2 to 4 hours. Play it all in one sitting or enjoy it in shorter sessions.

  • A relaxing experience with a few challenging moments. Take your time repairing consoles but stay alert when the evil consoles appear!

store_data.about_the_game:
Fall fast. Dodge faster. Dive deeper.

Cyber Dive is a fast, punishing 2D arcade fall through an endless cyberpunk city. Gravity only moves one way: straight down.

Dodge rotating blades, sliding traps, collapsing routes, narrow gaps, and flying hazards as you race deeper into the neon.

Quick Features

  • Fast 2D cyberpunk arcade falling

  • Up to 8-player multiplayer races

  • Focus mode to slow time

  • Cyber Dive mode for extreme speed

  • Near-miss combo scoring

  • Music-reactive visuals and dynamic soundtrack

  • 15+ original synth/cyber tracks

  • Instant deaths and instant restarts

Dive straight into danger

Trigger Cyber Dive and throw yourself downward at extreme speed. The city rushes toward you, the screen shakes, and the music hits harder.

It is risky, loud, and dangerous, but it can put you ahead of everyone else.

Slow time when the city gives you no room

Use Focus to slow the world around you, bend the soundtrack, and find the perfect path through impossible-looking gaps.

One perfect Focus can save your run.

Race your friends into the neon

Jump into the same descent with up to 8 players. Dodge the same hazards, fight for position, chat mid-run, and see who can reach the bottom fastest.

One reckless dive can put you in first. One bad dash can end everything.

Risk gets rewarded

Cyber Dive is not just about surviving. It is about surviving close.

Skim past obstacles, build near-miss combos, and push your score higher with every dangerous move.

The city moves with the music

Cyber Dive is built around speed, rhythm, and sound. Focus slows and glitches the music, Cyber Dive makes it rev harder, and the neon city pulses with the beat.

With 15+ original synth and cyber tracks plus an in-game radio, every fall has its own sound.

Full Feature List

  • Fast 2D cyberpunk arcade falling gameplay

  • Up to 8-player multiplayer races

  • Focus mode to slow time and survive brutal gaps

  • Cyber Dive mode for extreme speed and high-risk plays

  • Dash, jump, and dodge through dangerous obstacle patterns

  • Near-miss combo system that rewards risky movement

  • Music-reactive visuals and dynamic audio effects

  • 15+ original synth/cyber soundtrack tracks

  • In-game radio to choose your music

  • Procedural runs with escalating difficulty

  • Neon pixel-art characters with selectable glow colors

  • Instant deaths, instant restarts, endless one-more-run energy

store_data.about_the_game:
THE STORY

A cruise liner breaks apart in the open sea during a violent storm. You wake up alone on an empty shore — no signal, no allies, no idea where to even begin looking for anyone else.
The island seems uninhabited. It isn't.
The first person you find is another survivor — a stranger you shared nothing with before the wreck. Together, you have to relearn everything: finding water, building shelter, trusting each other enough to fall asleep side by side without fear. Closeness doesn't come by choice. It comes because there's no one else left to share the fear with.
But the island has a history that predates your shipwreck. Abandoned structures hidden in the jungle. Fragments of records stamped with the name of a long-forgotten project. A man who has survived here alone far longer than should be possible. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: your wreck wasn't the first thing to happen here. And it might not be the last.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

- Multiple romance routes, each with its own ending and explicit scenes.
- Survival, side by side: intimacy is built through shared effort, fear, and rare moments of peace — never forced by the plot.
- 18+ content woven into the story — the natural result of two people forced into closeness on the edge of survival.
- The mystery of the island's abandoned project, and the man who guarded it, unfolds gradually through discoveries and trust.

store_data.about_the_game:
You traverse a buried facility to perform what seems like a routine maintenance job: restore the power to each floor, return to the elevator, and continue downward.

The assignment is anything but routine.

Explore an abandoned underground complex where the facility changes with every attempt. Locate and activate the required breakers on each level while avoiding malfunctioning security systems, environmental hazards, and something far more dangerous hunting through the darkness.

The deeper you descend, the smarter and more aggressive the creature becomes. Learn its behavior, use the environment to survive, and uncover what SaniCore was really hiding beneath the surface.

HOW TO SURVIVE

Each floor presents new survival problems. Search branching corridors for the breakers needed to restore power, find keys and supplies, unlock blocked routes, and return to the elevator before the dangers below catch up with you.

Room layouts, routes, item placement, and hazards change with every descent, so memorizing a safe path is impossible. The deeper you travel, the more aggressively the creature hunts and the less predictable the facility becomes.

FEATURES

  • Different Facility Every Run - Room layouts, routes, objects, supplies, and hazards are procedurally arranged, making each descent unpredictable.

  • An Evolving Threat - The creature becomes more intelligent and dangerous as you reach deeper levels.

  • Hostile Conditions - Survive traps, automated defenses, darkness, and the remains of SaniCore’s failed operations.

  • Restore the Power - Locate the required breakers, reactivate each floor, and make it back to the elevator alive.

  • Uncover the Truth - Piece together the facility’s history through notes, employee records, and evidence left behind.

  • Reprinting - Death is not the end of your employment. SaniCore’s automated reprinting system sends another copy into the facility to continue the mission.

How deep can you get before the creature learns your every move?

store_data.about_the_game:
Coup de Grass is an incremental resource-management game about turning a tiny, hand-cut grass field into a sprawling automated industry.

It all started with a bizarre mutation...

A strange new species of grass has been discovered: fast-growing, incredibly resilient, and useful far beyond what anyone imagined. What began as a scientific curiosity quickly became the foundation of a new industry.

This unusual variety can be harvested at scale, processed into fuel, converted into power, used in construction, and refined into valuable products. Before the global rush begins, you are one of the first people trying to build a business around it.

Start with a small field and simple tools. Cut grass by hand, sell your harvest, invest in upgrades, hire workers, construct buildings, and discover just how far this strange new resource can be pushed.

Game loop and features:

  • Start small: begin with a humble sickle, a small field, and a lot of grass to cut.

  • Harvest, haul, sell, upgrade: cut grass, carry it to storage, sell it, then reinvest your profits into faster and more efficient production.

  • Hire workers: every task (such as cutting, hauling, manufacturing, researching) can be automated, putting you into a managerial role.

  • Manage real production flow: watch for travel routes, storage limits, resource bottlenecks, and cut out any inefficiencies as your business grows.

  • Construct buildings: buildings unlock new resources, mechanics, upgrades, and production chains to expand your grass empire.

  • Play active when you want to: bonus tasks and mini-games let you boost production manually while your automated, idle systems keep running in the background.

  • Move into new fields: reset your progress for permanent upgrades, then start again on a new field with its own theme, goal, and gameplay twist.

  • Explore varied levels: each field offers different mechanics and rewards you with extra prestige points for completing its objective.

store_data.about_the_game:
Innocent or guilty? In Sudokiller, your mission is to place every suspect exactly where they were the night of the crime. It's a cozy puzzle mystery game where you're in charge of cracking the case, one clue at a time.

Whether it's a guest bedroom, a busy kitchen, a cluttered greenhouse, or a hidden attic, every crime scene introduces a fresh cast of suspects with their own alibis and habits. A single missing piece of information can turn an open-and-shut case into a full-blown investigation. It's all about reading the clues to find the one arrangement that fits!

Each case unfolds inside a different room of a house full of secrets, filled with charming animal suspects and a victim who always takes the last open seat. Piece together who was where using pure deduction, no guessing, no trial and error, just one logical solution waiting to be uncovered.

  • Play detective and place every suspect using sudoku-style logic.

  • Who sat where, who had company, and who was never really alone.

  • Piece together satisfying puzzles with cozy scenarios to explore and cases to crack at your own pace.

  • Unlock new rooms and mansions as you progress, from easy to expert cases.

store_data.about_the_game:
lack File is a story-driven detective simulator set in the dark streets of Istanbul.

You play as a detective pulled back into a case that should have stayed buried. A phone call from an old contact leads you to a murder scene in Karaköy, where the victim is found holding a burned photograph connected to your father. What begins as a single investigation soon turns into a trail of lies, old records, broken loyalties, and a file that was never truly closed.  

Investigate Crime Scenes

Search carefully designed locations, examine suspicious details, and follow the evidence from a quiet detective office to the rain-soaked streets of Istanbul. Every scene is built to support the mystery, atmosphere, and slow-burning tension of a noir investigation.

Inspect Evidence in 3D

Evidence is not just collected; it must be examined. Rotate photographs, matchboxes, badges, and case items to discover hidden notes, marks, and clues that may change the direction of the investigation. In the demo, key evidence such as the burned photograph and the Yakut Pavilion matchbox push the detective toward the next lead.  

Connect Clues During Interrogations

Use the evidence you collect to pressure suspects and expose contradictions. During interrogations, the right connection between clues can break a lie and reveal the next step in the case.  

A Noir Istanbul Mystery

Black File combines isometric exploration, cinematic storytelling, dialogue-driven encounters, and atmospheric environments inspired by Istanbul’s darker corners: old apartments, detective offices, crime scenes, back rooms, and forgotten roads.

Features

  • Story-driven detective simulator

  • Isometric noir atmosphere

  • Crime scene investigation

  • 3D evidence inspection

  • Dialogue-heavy interrogation scenes

  • Clue connection and inventory-based progression

  • A dark mystery set in Istanbul

  • Single-player cinematic experience

The case is open.
And your name is written inside.
store_data.detailed_description:
lack File is a story-driven detective simulator set in the dark streets of Istanbul.

You play as a detective pulled back into a case that should have stayed buried. A phone call from an old contact leads you to a murder scene in Karaköy, where the victim is found holding a burned photograph connected to your father. What begins as a single investigation soon turns into a trail of lies, old records, broken loyalties, and a file that was never truly closed.  

Investigate Crime Scenes

Search carefully designed locations, examine suspicious details, and follow the evidence from a quiet detective office to the rain-soaked streets of Istanbul. Every scene is built to support the mystery, atmosphere, and slow-burning tension of a noir investigation.

Inspect Evidence in 3D

Evidence is not just collected; it must be examined. Rotate photographs, matchboxes, badges, and case items to discover hidden notes, marks, and clues that may change the direction of the investigation. In the demo, key evidence such as the burned photograph and the Yakut Pavilion matchbox push the detective toward the next lead.  

Connect Clues During Interrogations

Use the evidence you collect to pressure suspects and expose contradictions. During interrogations, the right connection between clues can break a lie and reveal the next step in the case.  

A Noir Istanbul Mystery

Black File combines isometric exploration, cinematic storytelling, dialogue-driven encounters, and atmospheric environments inspired by Istanbul’s darker corners: old apartments, detective offices, crime scenes, back rooms, and forgotten roads.

Features

  • Story-driven detective simulator

  • Isometric noir atmosphere

  • Crime scene investigation

  • 3D evidence inspection

  • Dialogue-heavy interrogation scenes

  • Clue connection and inventory-based progression

  • A dark mystery set in Istanbul

  • Single-player cinematic experience

The case is open.
And your name is written inside.
store_data.short_description: Black File is a story-driven detective simulator set in Istanbul. Investigate crime scenes, inspect evidence, connect clues, interrogate suspects, and uncover the truth behind a file that should have stayed closed.

store_data.about_the_game:
They call it the "Bermuda Triangle of Transylvania."

You are Alex, a man carrying a grief he can't escape and a guilt he can't name. When your dead lover's voice haunts your dreams and calls your name from the depths of the world's most haunted forest, you don't run away. You walk right in.

But something ancient waits between the trees. A cult is hunting, to please its evil master. And the truth about Isabella's death is more terrifying than any creature in these woods.

Run, hide and survive

You have no weapons. You cannot fight what stalks the Hoia Baciu, only vanish into the dark before it finds you. Slip beneath tables, into barrels, behind bushes, and hold your breath as death passes inches away. When your vision blurs and your pulse hammers in your ears, whatever haunts these woods has already found you and you have only once choice: run for your life.

Face Your Past

The deeper you go, the more the forest bleeds into memory. Isabella's voice echoes between the trees, calling, guiding, accusing, leading you toward the truth of a life left behind and a death you can't explain. Piece together what happened through the fragments twisted in your mind, and find your dead lover...or whatever called you here instead.

Any tool comes in handy

Scavenge the forest for the gear you'll need to survive and progress. A lighter and GPS help you find your way through the dark, while a journal lets you record the runes and symbols you discover along the way. When something gets too close, a flare gun can drive it back or buy you time to run, but ammo is limited, so use it carefully.

These are just a few of the items waiting to be found, each one a small advantage in a place that offers none.

The legends are real

Inspired by the chilling folklore of Romania's Hoia Baciu Forest, this is the first chapter in the Dark Realms series. On the surface, the woods are picturesque, but beneath that calm, darkness and evil spread like a plague, and no one who enters is ever seen walking out. The story unfolds across multiple chapters, each with its own mechanics, enemies,  collectables and secrets to uncover.

The things that share these woods are older than the cult that worships them. Drawn from the darkest corners of Romanian myth, each is a horror with its own nature and its own rules for surviving it:

  • The Moroi: the restless undead, risen from unquiet graves to feed on the living.

  • The Solomonar: a weather-wizard of forbidden knowledge, master of the storms and the beasts that answer to him.

  • Muma Pădurii: the Mother of the Forest, an ancient hag who preys on the lost and the wandering.

Decode the Forest

Ancient runes bar your path and mechanisms rust in forgotten huts. Solve environmental puzzles woven into the world while cross-referencing your symbols journal, read the signs the dead left behind, and unlock the routes that lead you deeper.

This game is a work of fiction inspired by real-world folklore. No real locations were harmed in the making. Please respect all real-world private property.

Mature Content: Contains gore, death, and extreme violence that some players may find disturbing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Type Shogun is a colorful educational typing adventure where keyboard practice becomes a battle to defend the Keyboard Kingdom.

Learn proper typing technique from the very beginning. Letters, numbers, words, symbols, and passages move across the screen. Type them before they reach your Shogun. Correct typing triggers sword attacks, while later challenges test your speed, accuracy, and focus.

Build keyboard confidence through play

Type Shogun helps players practice real keyboard skills in a more engaging way. Instead of staring at static drills, players learn by reacting, typing, improving, and progressing through a colorful shogun quest.

Save the Keyboard Kingdom

Begin with a guided tutorial, then progress through campaign battles that introduce new typing challenges step by step. Practice letters, capitalization, numbers, symbols, words, and passage-style typing as you fight toward the Dark Shogun's castle.

A unique keyboard guide overlay shows the key to press, while transparent hand and finger guidance helps players see which finger should reach each letter, number, or symbol. These visual learning tools help new typists build correct habits early by reinforcing home-row technique and finger-to-key memory as they play.

Parents can see the learning happen. As new typists follow the on-screen keyboard and transparent hand overlays, they are encouraged to press each key with the intended finger instead of hunting and pecking. From the first tutorial lesson, Type Shogun helps build the muscle memory behind proper home-row technique.

For new and experienced typists

Type Shogun is perfect for children and adults. Guided typing help, adjustable challenge settings, Sandbox practice, and WPM tests give beginners room to learn while giving stronger typists ways to practice speed, accuracy, and consistency.

Practice your way

Sandbox Mode lets you customize typing practice with adjustable speed, spawn timing, target types, and challenge settings. Make practice calmer, faster, simpler, or more intense depending on what you want to train.

Test your speed

WPM Mode includes timed typing tests, generated word streams, quotes, paragraphs, custom text practice, saved seeds, and local records for repeatable challenges.

  • Colorful typing adventure campaign

  • Beginner-friendly tutorial

  • Letters, numbers, words, symbols, and passages

  • On-screen keyboard guide

  • Transparent hand and finger guidance

  • Customizable challenges for first-time typists and experienced keyboard users

  • Sandbox practice mode

  • WPM test mode

  • Built-in typing practice library

  • Custom text practice

  • Saved seeds and local records

  • Adjustable difficulty, text size, contrast, and volume options

  • Keyboard-only option (no mouse required to play)

  • Single-player

  • Available on Windows and macOS

A keyboard-first adventure

Type Shogun is designed around typing. Use your keyboard to practice skills, defeat targets, and protect the kingdom.

Learn to type. Master the keyboard. Save the kingdom.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lexicon is a word based puzzle game wrapped inside a strange abandoned computer system. You explore forgotten terminals, sift through corrupted files, and solve linguistic challenges that twist familiar rules into something unsettling. Every puzzle reveals a fragment of a larger story that hides beneath the interface, waiting for you to notice the patterns that are not supposed to be there.

The deeper you go, the more the system reacts to you. Symbols shift. Meanings change. Clues appear in places you did not expect. Lexicon rewards curiosity and careful observation, inviting you to uncover a narrative that feels like it has been waiting for someone to wake it up.

If you enjoy puzzles that feel alive and stories that reveal themselves through the act of solving, Lexicon offers a quiet and creeping mystery built from language itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every assassin wears a costume — and the crowd is full of innocents wearing the same one.

CARNEVALE is a party game of hidden assassins for 2–10 players. One copy of the game hosts on the big screen; everyone else joins in seconds from their phone or PC's browser — no app, no account, no purchase.

Your phone whispers a contract: the name of the player you're hunting, and the costume they wear. Somewhere in the plaza, they're walking among a dozen AI copies of themselves. Walk like the crowd. Stop like the crowd. Watch for the figure that moves like a human — and put a blade in them before someone does the same to you.

The crowd is alive

Crowds stroll in pairs, gather at fountains, browse the stalls, and stop to chat. They notice the dead — some stare, some panic, some quietly take the long way around. Watch the watchers: a knot of gawkers means a kill happened there.

Six plazas, sized to your party

From the tight and tense Courtyard (2–4) to the crammed Mercato di Rialto, the classic Piazza Grande, the basilica square of the Cattedrale, the hedge alleys of the Giardini della Villa, and the waterfront Grand Canal (6–10).

Eight dirty tricks — equip two

Smoke Bomb, Disguise, Morph, Decoy, Firecrackers, Poison Blade, Eagle Sense, Adrenaline. Whiff your blade and the whole plaza sees it swing.

Built for the couch

A live kill-cam, a running leaderboard, and a slow-mo highlight reel between rounds. A heartbeat pulses under the music when a blade closes on its mark. Add bots to fill the roster, crown a co-host so a phone can run the game, and let the handicap settings keep blowouts honest.

Phones are the controllers

Free web join with a QR code — friends are in the game in under 30 seconds. Full living world view on modern phones, or classic minimap mode where all eyes stay on the TV.—Join the community — share clips, find a lobby, and talk to the dev on Discord:

You are just a cat, with a weapon in hand inside a castle tower surrounded by monsters of all kinds.

Bloodspire brings the thrill of classic Roguelike games! Challenge your friends or family in this intense game.

  • Fire Up (Creates a flame above your character that damages enemies.)

  • Fire Left (Creates a flame to the left of your character that damages enemies.)

  • Fire Right (Creates a flame to the right of your character that damages enemies.)

store_data.about_the_game:
A magical educational adventure

Pago Forest 2: Frozen Memories is an educational point-and-click fantasy adventure with a graphic novel atmosphere, story-driven quests and turn-based battles based on English spelling.

Set ten years before the events of Pago Forest: Dragon’s Revenge, the story follows Flora, Freyja and Ramia as they discover the Mage Federation Academy, a mysterious place filled with magic, knowledge and danger.

Learn English through the story

As the adventure progresses, players improve their English spelling and grammar through natural learning activities integrated into the journey. Instead of isolated exercises, learning becomes part of the story, the exploration and the challenges faced by the characters. Players will review English words, spelling rules, grammar tips and vocabulary while exploring a fantasy world threatened by cold, mystery and forgotten memories.



Point-and-click exploration

Explore magical locations, follow the story, meet characters, discover secrets and progress through a snowy fantasy world filled with warriors, mages, dwarves, dragons, golems, chimeras, frost giants and other fantastic creatures.

Spelling-based turn-based battles

Face enemies in turn-based battles where spelling and English knowledge become your main weapons. Choose carefully, answer correctly and help Flora and her friends overcome the dangers that stand in their way.

A fantasy adventure for young players and families

Designed for players aged 8 and up, Pago Forest 2: Frozen Memories offers a gentle educational experience for children, families and anyone who wants to practice English in a different way.

Features

- Educational point-and-click fantasy adventure
- Graphic novel-style storytelling
- English spelling and grammar activities integrated into the story
- Turn-based battles based on spelling
- Story-driven quests and exploration
- A snowy magical world filled with mystery
- Characters, professions and creatures to discover
Dragons, golems, mages, dwarves, chimeras and frost giants
- More than 30 levels
- Adventure Mode with Flora as the main playable character
- Designed for players aged 8 and up

A frozen threat is spreading

On the other side of the continent, something mysterious is growing. The climate is changing, the cold is spreading, and the city must prepare to face a danger as strange as it is fearsome.

Help Flora, Freyja and Ramia uncover the secrets of the Mage Federation Academy and experience a magical adventure where learning English becomes part of the journey.

4918850.name: Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King

store_data.about_the_game:
When the hunt is over, the hound is thrown away. He learned that in the Amazon.

Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King is a dark fantasy visual novel adapted from the 475-chapter Korean web novel epic Lord of Lords by Wolwoon — an official adaptation commissioned by the original author.





Chansung, 27, is the legendary platoon leader of the Blue Dragon Battalion, Korea's most secret special forces unit. An orphan who clawed his way up from the streets, he trusted only two things: his men, and the chain of command.



Then a reconnaissance mission deep in the Amazon turns out to be a death trap — set by his own commander. One by one, his men give their lives to keep him breathing, and Chansung learns exactly what happens to a hunting dog once the hunt is over.



At the edge of death, an otherworldly being makes him an offer — and he falls through a rift between dimensions.



He awakens in a world of Gates — a brutal ecosystem where "Gaters" earn points, conquer gates, and fight for standing among demons, elves, dwarves, and monsters. And Chansung carries a trait almost no one has ever held: Lord — the power to bind the strong to his name.



Betrayal made him a stray. The Gates will make him a king.



  • The original saga, reborn as a game — Not a novel pasted onto a screen: an official adaptation, restructured and paced for play, told through character staging and expressions, 100+ illustrated CG scenes, and an original score of 60+ music, ambience, and sound cues.
  • Choices carved into your Chronicle — Decisions at major turning points quietly shape your route, trust, and reputation. Every major resolve is recorded in your Chronicle — and together they decide which of the multiple endings your story reaches.
  • Light LitRPG progression — Points, gates, traits, and named companions, systemized straight from the novel's own rules.
  • A dark lord's tale — Betrayal, survival, revenge, and conquest. No power without a price.
  • Premium and complete — A single-purchase, single-player experience. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.




Chansung — The Betrayed Soldier
Orphan, soldier, legend of the Blue Dragon Battalion — and a hunting dog discarded by the men he served. In the world of Gates he holds the near-mythical trait Lord, the power to make the strong kneel and rise with him. Calm, blunt, and merciless to traitors, he rebuilds from nothing: first a squad, then an army, then a throne.


Celline — The First Companion
An elf-blooded archmage of Gate E-398, and the finest magic user of her world. She is the first to swear herself to Chansung as his companion — her magic carries his earliest battles, and her quiet, unwavering devotion becomes something he never expected to have again: someone to protect.


Baljak — The Strongest Vassal
A Hero-grade ogre of Gate E-318 who all but conquered its ogres, trolls, and elves alone. Four meters of scarred muscle, magic-resistant hide, and a club the size of a tree — bound and named by Chansung, he becomes the most terrifying weapon in his lord's arsenal. He cannot speak, but he never misunderstands an order.


Keirin — The Guide
A Great General of the demon king Satan, and the reason Chansung's second life begins at all. On a whim — or something more — she pulls a dying soldier from the edge of death and sends him through the Gate with a guidebook and a priceless activation talisman. Capricious, unbothered, and strangely fond of one particular human.


Arpetia — The Administrator
The demon administrator of neutral Zone 216, where new Gaters come to register for their point dispensers. Devastatingly beautiful and casually sadistic, she treats overeager rookies as entertainment. The man who withstands her allure without flinching earns something far more dangerous than her wrath: her interest.



From a discarded soldier to the beginning of a true lord. Play the story as it was reborn for the screen, make the choices that matter, and take the first step toward the throne.

Wishlist Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King — and be there when the Gate opens.
